EnemiesScalingUp.src: As your numbers grow, so grows Ashenfall's bloodlust. Enemies grow more powerful.

EnemiesScalingDown.src: Ashenfall's bloodlust diminishes as your allies depart.

SpamWarning.src: You are spamming the chat. Please wait a moment.

CrystalHelixShard.Desc.src: A broken fragment of the Crystal Helix

Dead.VaultGuardian.NoQuest.1.src: A decommissioned Vault Guardian. Very odd.

MagicalBarrier.Intro.1.src: A wall of energy blocks the path. The air hums with power.

Zanik.Branch.3.src: Ah, you found the dismembered vault guardian? Yeah, that was my handiwork. In fact, it's something I would like to discuss...

Zanik2.CrystalsShattered.3.src: All that's left is for me to deal with the giant Avisk crystal on the surface.

Zanik2.QuestComplete.1.src: Avisk 0, Team Adventurers 1. We should get out of here.

Zanik2.Intro.2.src: Avisk is everywhere, mortals! Adventurerer, complete your quest. All that remains is for you to jump into the hole with the Crystal Helix. It will take you directly to Fuzan!

Objective.6.src: Break the four crystals in the Shortcut Chamber of the Kalphite Hive

VaultGuardianPrime.Return.1.src: Carry on the mission... Use the Crystal Helix to pass through the magical barrier.

VaultGuardianPrime.HelixComplete.1.src: Crystal Helix fragments detected. You carry them, Vault Guardian Prime.

VaultGuardianPrime.HelixComplete.3.src: Deliver fragments to this unit. Unit will then repair the Crystal Helix.

Zanik2.Intro.5.src: Don't listen to the goblin! Jump into the hole like a good mortal!

Crystal4.Shattered.2.src: Don't think that this is the end. We will meet again, puny human.

Zanik2.NoSpace.1.src: Er, could you clear out some of the stuff in your inventory? I can't give you the reward with so much in there.

Objective.2.src: Find 3 missing vault guardians and recover their Crystal Helix fragments

Avisk.Return.NoHelix.1.src: Find my defunct vault guardians, gather fragments of the Crystal Helix, and use them together to open up a shortcut to Fuzan in the cave back there.

Objective.1.src: Find the Vault Guardian Prime in the Kalphite Hive

Objective.2.1.src: Follow the footsteps in the sand to find who made them

VaultGuardianPrime.Response.3.src: Fragments withheld. Directive cannot be fulfilled. Return when ready.

Avisk.QuestComplete.1.src: Going by the lack of colour in the crystal, Avisk is no longer home.

Zanik2.Intro.3.src: Ha! Like we'd believe that, you goofy carbon deposit! Notice how there's heat coming from the hole? Avisk must want the Crystal Helix melted in the lava or geyser that lies down there.

Zanik2.CrystalsShattered.4.src: Here, have a reward for trusting me over that fancy pebble. I found it in a tunnel that led into this cave. Looks impressive.

Zanik.Intro.3.src: How does that sound? If you're in, you will be needing this...

Avisk.Intro.3.src: I did have some vault guardians, who had hands at least, but they seem to have expired. It's really rather irritating.

Avisk.Return.QuestIncomplete.1.src: I suppose your mushy mortal mind has forgotten the current objective.

Avisk.Intro.4.src: I want you to find my vault guardians and retrieve a Crystal Helix they were carrying. It is the key to a... shortcut which leads directly to Fuzan's Volcano.

Zanik.Intro.1.src: I was wondering when you’d show up!

Zanik.Intro.2.src: I'd like to suggest an alternative plan. You complete the Crystal Helix, then we access this Shortcut Chamber - whatever it is - and then we undermine whatever Avisk's REAL plan is.

Crystal.Desc.1.src: It is a red crystal with a deep glow to it.

Zanik.Branch.1.src: It is incredibly good to see you, but we have a problem - a problem we need to align on.

Buried.Guardian.NoShards.1.src: Its energy core flickers weakly. There is space for 4 vault shards in the core. Perhaps they would reactivate it?

PitVaultGuardian.Intro.2.src: Kalphite assault… overwhelming. Game over man... Game over...

Zanik.PostObjective.src: Keep working on that Crystal Helix. I'm going to see if there's another way past that magical barrier.

VaultGuardianPrime.Intro.3.src: Mission handover: the Crystal Helix was… shattered into three fragments.

Crystal3.Shattered.2.src: Must I be humiliated? Why am I always the one who is shamed?

VaultGuardianPrime.QuestDone.1.src: My objective is complete. I can rest now.

Zanik2.Intro.4.src: Of course! Avisk wants to diffuse his consciousness to the kalphite and the Kalphite Queen! In what world was that plan going to work, Avisk?

VaultGuardianPrime.NoHelix.2.src: One lies buried… outside... within a ruin of some kind.

VaultGuardianPrime.NoHelix.3.src: One was captured... in this cave. An obstruction pins the unit in place.

Zanik.Response.1.src: Ooh, very clandestine! Keep your friends close and your enemies closer, right? Close enough to put them in a headlock.

Zanik.NoSpace.1.src: Or, at least, you would if you had space. Make some room and then we can go undercover.

Avisk.Intro.2.src: Our paths cross again, mortal! I have need of someone with legs, hands and an impressionable character. While they are common evolutionary traits, I'm lacking them all here in the desert.

Crystal2.Shattered.2.src: Perhaps we could work together? You can have Ghornfell. I have no use for Ghornfell.

Zanik2.Intro.6.src: Pffrt. What do you say we play a bit of whack-a-crystal? Get your pickaxe out.

Zanik2.Intro.1.src: Phew! Definitely took the harder route into this cave. Wait a minute - are those crystals the same as the one outside?

Player.Choice.Shards.1.src: Place 4 vault shards into the core

VaultGuardianPrime.Intro.2.src: Protocol override. Vault Guardian Prime status will be conferred to new subject. YOU are now Vault Guardian Prime.

Objective.7.src: Return to Zanik in the Shortcut Chamber within the Kalphite Hive

Objective.3.src: Return to the Vault Guardian Prime

DeadVaultGuardian.Intro.3.src: Small footprints lead away from the ruined guardian. They look like they belong to something goblin-sized.

PitVaultGuardian.Intro.3.src: Take the Crystal Helix fragment… Complete the task…

Objective.5.src: Talk to Zanik in the Shortcut Chamber within the Kalphite Hive

Zanik.Return.QuestComplete.1.src: Thanks for helping with that dragonkin buffoon. I slipped a dagger into the vein of consciousness within his crystal. It's only a setback for him, as he will have other crystals for his mind to retreat into.

Avisk.Intro.5.src: That interests you, yes? You want to confront Fuzan, don't you? Use the Crystal Helix to access a secret entrance in the nearby cave. Help me and we both benefit.

Zanik2.CrystalsShattered.1.src: That should be it! We've undermined his plan to mind-meld with the kalphite and the Kalphite Queen. Who knows what THAT might have been like.

MagicalBarrier.Complete.1.src: The Crystal Helix spins brightly in your hands. The barrier shifts and matches the light of the Crystal Helix. It allows you to pass.

MagicalBarrier.NoHelix.1.src: The barrier pulses as you touch it, then shoves you back.

MagicalBarrier.NoHelix.2.src: The barrier seemed to scan you for something, then shoved you back once it found it missing.

Crystal3.Shattered.1.src: The chamber shakes as you throttle the vein.

DeadVaultGuardian.Intro.2.src: The core housing has been pried open. If the Crystal Helix was here, it has been taken.

VaultGuardianPrime.NoHelix.4.src: The last rests near some eggs of the kalphite... on the surface...

PitVaultGuardian.Intro.4.src: The light in its core fades.

Buried.Guardian.Intro.1.src: The vault guardian lies half-buried in the sand, its frame twisted and silent.

DeadVaultGuardian.Intro.1.src: The vault guardian lies shattered, its frame torn apart. Deep score marks cut through the plating.

Player.NotPlaceShards.1.src: The vault guardian's core flickers with what seems like sadness.

Buried.Guardian.PlacedShards.1.src: The vault shards magnetise into place.

Crystal1.Shattered.1.src: The vein within the crystal pops disgustingly.

CrystalHelix.Desc.src: This is the fully restored Crystal Helix, which will grant passage through the magical barrier within the Kalphite Hive

VaultGuardianPrime.Intro.4.src: Three vault guardians are in possession of them. Recover the fragments… and this unit can restore the Crystal Helix. Then... magical barrier will open.

Objective.4.src: Use the Crystal Helix to pass through the magical barrier in the Kalphite Hive

Avisk.Return.FoundHelix.1.src: What are you waiting for? You have the Crystal Helix. Go into the Kalphite Hive, pass the magical barrier, and meet your doo... victory!

QuestDesc.src: Work with Avisk to find a potential shortcut to Fuzan's Volcano

Zanik.Response.2.src: You better believe something is off! Avisk has zero interest in finding a shortcut to Fuzan. It's a big old stinking ruse.

Crystal1.Shattered.2.src: You can't destroy Avisk! I have many places like this - full of my consciousness.

Buried.Guardian.Helix.NoSpace.1.src: You don't have space to take the Crystal Helix fragment.

Zanik.NotTalkedtoPrime.1.src: You made it into the Umbral Sands! It was never in doubt. I'm a little busy now, but shall we catch up later?

Zanik.Intro.1b.src: You seem to be helping Avisk, but you're too clever to REALLY be helping Avisk. You have an angle on this, don't you?

Crystal4.Shattered.1.src: You yank the vein out of the pedestal.

AttackDirectionMode.Description.src: Determine the direction that an action (attacking, blocking, evading) should be performed in.

ControllerMovementDeadzone.Description.src: The minimum amount of input required before movement will occur

ControllerAimDeadzone.Description.src: The minimum amount of input required before the camera will move

Slopfinger.QuestComplete.NoSpace.1.src: 'Cept you haven't got any room in your bag, 'ave ya? Come back later so I can give you a gift or two.

Milk.Desc.src: A bucket of milk from a stubborn cow.

Cake.Desc.src: A cake requested by Slopfinger, made by you, and intended for Manktongue.

Player.Ingredients.Choice.Milk.1.src: Ask about a bucket of milk

QuestObjective.2.src: Bake a cake using the stove next to Slopfinger.

Slopfinger.Intro.1.src: Blimey, I seen a lot of hoomans, but ain't you a big 'un?

QuestObjective.3.src: Bring the signed cake to Manktongue.

Slopfinger.Eggs.1.src: Chicken or terrorbird eggs will do. We don't need to get too fancy.

Manktongue.NoCake.2.src: Da cake is a lie! Hehe.

Player.Choice.3.src: Did you just write your name in spit?

Player.Stove.GotItems.1.src: Do you want to put the ingredients inside the stove?

Slopfinger.Wheat.2.src: Find some wheat seeds and a farmin' patch, and do whatever it is that farmers do. Remember, we need 6 lots of wheat.

Slopfinger.Milk.2.src: Findin' a dairy cow is the problem. Not so many of them round Ghornfell.

QuestObjective.1.src: Gather 4 eggs, 6 wheat and a bucket of milk, and bring them all to Slopfinger.

Slopfinger.GotCake.Return.1.src: Go give da cake to Manktongue.

Slopfinger.GotItems.4.src: Goodness no! My hands are all wobbly at the thought of Manktongue learnin' ma name.

Player.Choice.4.src: He said, and I quote: "tell Slopfinger he's earned himself a raise".

QuestDesc.src: Help Slopfinger in Ghornfell bake a memorable cake for Manktongue.

Manktongue.CakeDelivered.2.src: Hop to it! Fortune waits for no gobber.

Slopfinger.GotItems.1.src: I can tell from the way you're walkin' that you've got bakery stuffs for me.

Slopfinger.QuestComplete.3.src: I feel a growin' pride in the work I do. I cannot fank you enough.

Player.Choice.HadCakeLostIt.src: I had a cake, but I lost it.

Slopfinger.QuestComplete.1.src: I saw the cake go in his lughole! What did he say?

Slopfinger.GotCake.4.src: I'll be back here with my heart fully in ma mouth.

Slopfinger.Eggs.2.src: I'll want four of da blighters, so that the cake will rise as high as my blood pressure.

Slopfinger.Milk.4.src: I've been trying not to maintain eye contact. Been on edge the whole day.

Slopfinger.Intro.4.src: If only I could think of a way to get Manktongue to remember my name...

Slopfinger.Intro.7.src: If you need any 'elp wiv finding any of it, ya know where I am.

Slopfinger.Milk.3.src: Is it? Blimey - I thought it were a bear.

Player.Ingredients.Choice.Milk.2.src: Isn't that a Dairy Cow over there?

Slopfinger.QuestComplete.4.src: It ain't much, but I want ya to 'ave this. Perhaps, one day, you will find a boss as good as Manktongue.

Player.MadeCake.1.src: It's a cake, made for you by Slopfinger

Slopfinger.GotItems.2.src: It's a talent. It can't be taught.

Slopfinger.Wheat.1.src: It's not my for-tay, but I believe it involves farmin'.

Cow.Pet.1.src: It's smooth, like a wide, hornless unicorn.

Player.ObserveManktongue.1.src: Manktongue pushes some cake into his ear, where it nestles next to the pie.

Slopfinger.Intro.2.src: Name is Slopfinger. I work for Manktongue ova there. I'm his cook, assistant, butler, mass-ooze and hype-goblin.

Slopfinger.Choice.Intro.1.src: Need any help with da stuff?

Slopfinger.GotItems.3.src: Next step is to make the cake. You look like ya know yer way 'round a stove. Why don't you have a go?

Slopfinger.Intro.3.src: Not that he notices me. Yesterday I was crackin' 'is back an' he called me Sweatmonger. Sweatmonger!

Slopfinger.GotCake.2.src: Now, don't look for a moment. I need to apply my sig-nah-ture.

Manktongue.NoCake.1.src: Oi oi! You got somethin' for ol' Manktongue?

Manktongue.GotCake.1.src: Oi oi, what do we have 'ere?

Manktongue.GotCake.4.src: Ooh, the icin' is drip-droppin' on ma eardrum.

QuestObjective.4.src: Show Slopfinger the freshly cooked cake.

Player.NoIngredients.1.src: Slopfinger said that I need 4 eggs, 6 wheat and a bucket of milk to bake the cake.

Manktongue.GotCake.5.src: Tell 'Slopfinger he's earned himself a raise.

Slopfinger.GotCake.1.src: That cake is ace. Truly ace.

Cow.Wheat.2.src: The Dairy Cow chews the wheat without once taking its eyes off you.

Cow.Milk.Denied.1.src: The Dairy Cow gives you a kick to the shins.

Cow.Intro.1.src: The Dairy Cow gives you the side-eye.

Cow.ChoiceComplete.NoItem.1.src: The Dairy Cow notes that you have no inventory space and rolls her eyes. You will need to come back when you have room for a bucket of milk.

Cow.ChoiceComplete.1.src: The Dairy Cow permits you to milk her.

Cow.NoQuest.1.src: The cow looks supremely confident within its own body. It's to be admired, really.

Cow.Compliment.1.src: The cow rolls its eyes but blushes a little.

Cow.Wheat.1.src: The cow turns its head expectedly.

Slopfinger.GotCake.3.src: The spit will show up well on da frostin'. Now hurry, give the cake to Manktongue.

Manktongue.GotCake.2.src: Wait, wot's written on da cake? Does that say Slopfinger? Da goblin in da kitchen?

Slopfinger.NoHelp.1.src: We all need help. But you work that out for yoursel'.

Manktongue.NoCake.3.src: Well, come back over when you've made a new 'un.

Slopfinger.QuestComplete.2.src: What a ruddy charmer! He even remembered ma name!

Player.Choice.1.src: Why not bake him a cake with your name on it?

Player.Stove.2.src: You close your eyes,  jumble the ingredients together, and place them in the stove. Surely this won't work.

Manktongue.CakeDelivered.1.src: You given Slopfinger da news about da raise?

Player.NoWheat.1.src: You have no wheat to feed the cow.

Slopfinger.Intro.5.src: You know what, I utterly forgot that I'm a cook! Yer a genie-ooze.

Slopfinger.Intro.6.src: You shall be the assistant's assistant. We will need 4 eggs, 6 lots of wheat and a bucket of milk.

Player.Stove.4.src: You step back from the stove.

Slopfinger.Wheat.3.src: You won't need to make flour or anythin'. I like my cakes to look like sad bread.

Slopfinger.Milk.1.src: You'll need to milk a Dairy Cow. I don't advise milkin' anything else.

SmithAnvil.Description.src: A Blacksmith's Anvil. Required for working with metals.

Station.ToolsMeleeBench1.Description.src: A dedicated bench to craft all your tools and melee weapons.

Station.FlethchingBench1.Description.src: A dedicated station for all your bows and crossbows.

Station.ArmourBench1.Description.src: A dedicated station to craft all the armour you could possibly need.

Kiln.Description.src: A heated kiln, used to fire pottery.

LoomHarness.Description.src: A loom improvement. The loom harness grants an additional slot to the loom, allowing the loom to weave more complex textiles.

Grill.Description.src: A much improved home cooking fire with no need for fuel

Campfire.Description.src: A nice hot fire on which to cook food or purify dirty water.

FermentationBarrel.Description.src: A processing station that is capable of imbuing liquids with new properties over a long period of time.

Tannery.Description.src: A rack that slowly processes animal hide into leather.

CraftingTable.Description.src: A simple crafting station equipped with an array of primitive tools. It is used to craft equipment and other important resources.

SpinningWheel.Description.src: A spinning wheel can spin fibres such as flax or fleece into threads for crafting with.

CookingPot.Description.src: A sturdy pot over a campfire that can be used to combine ingredients to make better meals and infuse water with berries or other ingredients.

TannersKit.Description.src: A tannery improvement. The tanner's kit adds another build slot to the tanning station, allowing you to create more complex materials.

CookingRange.Description.src: A workstation dedicated to food. A cooking range can be used to combine cooked ingredients into hearty meals, create delicious beverages and even brew the Plant Cure potion.

Station.Tannery2.Description.src: Allows you to process tougher animal hides into leather.

Runecrafting.Description.InfusionPhase.src: As the attuned rune fills with power, mend it's cracks to contain the magic within and safeguard you bonus runes.

Furnace.Description.src: By burning charcoal to create a blazing hot flame, the furnace is able to fire clay, and smelt ores into metal bars.

Runecrafting.Description.AttunementPhase.src: Find an attunement frequency to infuse the runes with magical energy. Higher attunement levels grant additional bonus runes.

Runecrafting.Description.ResultPhase.src: Mend the cracks quickly to secure bonus runes!

AdvancedFurnace.Description.src: The blast furnace uses intense heat to smelt high tier metal ores into ingots.

Loom.Description.src: The device processes threads into textiles and cloth.

BrewingCauldron.Description.src: This cauldron is used to brew potions.

Grindstone.Description.src: This tool can crush stone, bones, and other things, into fine dust.

Masterwork.Idle.src: Upgrade the Power Level of <Weapon>Masterwork Weapons</> and <Armor>Armor</>

RuneAltar.Description.src: Used for crafting Runes, the magical stones needed to cast magic.

PotteryWheel.Description.src: Used for fashioning clay items. Bowls, pots, and jewellery moulds can be crafted at this station and then fired in a furnace.

Station.MysticForge1.Description.src: Used to craft magic weapons and for ascending masterworks and vestiges.

JewelersBench.Description.src: Used to craft magical items from precious metals and gems.

Death.ImaruSlain.HasHead.HasSpace.1.src: A foul thing, really. Corrupted beyond repair. I almost pity her. Still, you're not interested in that, I feel you'll enjoy this much more.

Seal.SilverthornKeep.NotActivated.1.src: A terrible despair works its way into your bones, making you shiver from the coldness of it all. As you take the power for yourself some warmth returns.

Death.AskAbout.Death.1.src: Ah, but you know me already, don't you? I am the shadow over your shoulder, inching ever closer until you take that final breath. You have always known me, because you await me each day.

PostiePete.Soulrifted.1.src: Ah, feel a little light in the soul there? That's Soul Rift for you. On the plus side, you'll see things you couldn't see before. On the downside you're a dragon's dinner waiting to happen.

Cathan.StandingStones.Intro.3.src: All these shambling corpses causing trouble, that's her doing. Their spirits ripped out of them, leaving just enough to keep them wandering.

EmberwoodPuzzle.ArmadylStatue.MainStatue.src: An interesting deduction, but an incorrect one. Speak to the spirits once more and look for the discrepancies in their tales.

Cathan.PostQuest.1.src: Another dragon down, eh? The mainland must be missing you! I bet you'd have solved half the world's problems by now.

Cathan.PostQuest.2.src: As for me, nothing new really. Death's not come to reap me yet, think he might even like me. Maybe if I keep working along side you I can stave off the ever-after for a little while longer.

PlayerChoice.ArmadylPuzzle.Motive.Right..src: Because they thought it was funny.

Cathan.SecondSealObtained.2.src: Being sacrificed to a dragon somewhat ruins that. Still, I'm going to try my best at the ghostly sidekick gig. Maybe I can be a footnote in one of your adventures somewhere?

WoM.AshiensWatchLocation.NotDoneDragonSl.src: But, anyway, aren't you busy? Shouldn't you be off looking at how best to stab old Velgar to death? Feels like you should be focusing your attention on that, hrmm? Go on, get!

Death.AskAbout.Underworld.4.src: But, death isn't really something you need to worry about for a while. I've decided to keep you from passing on until you've cleared up a few problems for me. Just don't get too carried away.

EmberwoodPuzzle.ArmadylStatue.MainStatue.src: Cast your verdict arbiter. What crime was committed?

Cathan.ImaruSlain.1.src: Dragons don't stand a chance against you! Best go speak to big tall and boney, so he can confirm she's dead and gone. I'll wait here, I guess.

PostiePete.QuestInProgress.2.src: Enjoying yourself in Fellhollow? Yeah, I wouldn't take a holiday there either. Don't do too many holidays anyway, I don't like spending them on my own and, well, I've just got no-body to go with.

Objective.DefeatImaru.src: Enter the Shattered Spire and defeat Imaru.

Objective.InvestigateStones.src: Find Cathan and look into what he was investigating.

Objective.GatherCurseFragments.3.src: Find the last curse fragment from the locations described in the standing stones.

Death.PostQuest.NoHeads.1.src: Forgive me, but I must focus my attention elsewhere. There is an enormous backlog in Fellhollow that I need to clear up.

Death.FoundStones.4.src: Fortunately, curses like this can be modified. They're not the more fairytale affair, none of that true love nonsense. Instead there will be a number of seals, special shrines dedicated to holding onto some aspect of the curse. You can take a piece of the curse for yourself, from each of these shrines. Get enough of them and you'll be strong enough to challenge Imaru directly.

Objective.GatherCurseFragments.1.src: Gather three curse fragments from the locations described in the standing stones.

Objective.GatherCurseFragments.2.src: Gather two more curse fragments from the locations described in the standing stones.

Death.FoundStones.1.src: Good, you understand the situation now. Imaru, a soul-devouring dragon, cursed with an unending hunger and afflicted with an eternal rage. Not a good combination.

Death.FirstSealObtained.1.src: Good. I can feel the necromantic energy fluctuating, Once you've empowered yourself at all three seals then you should be able to face Imaru in her tower. Then you can put an end to her suffering, and start Fellhollow back on the slow path to healing.

Cathan.FirstSealObtained.1.src: Great work on that first seal! You're already looking stronger, spiritually speaking. Get the other two and we should be able to deal with Imaru. By we, I mean you, obviously, but I'll be cheering from the sides... very far away sides.

Seal.Emberwood.NotActivated.1.src: Grief, sorrow and fear unravel at your fingertips. A curse woven from the despair of the villagers finally stills. You take a piece of that sorrow for yourself.

Death.AskAbout.Death.4.src: Guthix himself gave me the scythe and robes I use to this day. It is my honour and my duty to cut the tether that traps souls to this world, allowing the dead to move on to the Underworld.

EmberwoodPuzzle.ArmadylStatue.Snickering.src: Ha! Then the screaming happened, man it was funny!

Cathan.ThirdSealObtained.2.src: Ha! Wish I'd learned that before I died, it would have made things a whole lot easier, and I'd probably still be alive today. Still, no point dwelling over spilled arterial fluid.

Death.QuestNotStarted.Intro.2.src: Haha, just a little joke... Mostly. You'll probably die a few times, but I'll bring you back like I have been doing. I still have work for you after all. I know why you're here, little bit of a problem with the dead not actually dying.

Death.ImaruSlain.HasHead.1.src: Here let me take that dragon head from you.

Cathan.StandingStones.Intro.1.src: Hey there friend, good to see you again. The Wise Old Man was getting on my nerves a bit, so I thought I might try and give you a hand. Been looking into everything and you're not gonna want to hear this, but there's another ruddy dragon at play. Only, get this, she's already dead.

PostiePete.Intro.1.src: Hey there, bit lost? No-body to point you in the right direction for a good tailor?... Because, frankly, your look could use some work. I assume you're trying to get into Fellhollow? Nasty place. I wouldn't be seen dead there.

Death.NotFoundStones.1.src: Hrmm, what are you doing here? Shouldn't you be investigating Fellhollow?

Death.ImaruSlain.HasHead.NoSpace.1.src: Hrmm, you appear to be a little overburdened. Shed yourself some of thy worldly trappings and then come speak to me again.

Death.AskAbout.Death.3.src: I died, that's what got me this job. I was the very first person to die on Gielinor. Hardly the most glamorous of accolades, but someone had to. In so dying I became Death, capital D, the reaper of souls.

WoM.AshiensWatch.NotFinishedQuest.Generi.src: I don't know what you're talking to me for. Aren't you busy doing stuff through that creepy door down this tunnel? Go on, get!

Death.FoundStones.5.src: I feel sorry for her. This was not her fault, nor her fate, but the world is cruel and there is no way to undo what was done without her destruction. So gear up, get yourself cursed, and take her down.

Death.ImaruSlain.2.src: I knew one of you would luck out eventually, I'm glad it was you. Oh, yes, sorry, no chosen ones here. But ignore that, you did good, better than the rest, so you deserve what you came for.

Death.QuestStarted.NotEnteredFellhollow..src: I need you to investigate Fellhollow. Find out what went on. Resolve it if you can and I shall reward you for your efforts. As well as continue this little resurrection situation. A fair bargain, I'm sure you agree.

Death.QuestNotStarted.Intro.4.src: I need you to investigate this. Find out what went on. Resolve it if you can and I shall reward you for your efforts. As well as continue this little resurrection situation. A fair bargain, I'm sure you agree.

EmberwoodPuzzle.ArmadylStatue.Suspicious.src: I never get invited to parties, but this house party was something special, you know? A great achievement, deserving of celebration, how could I turn it down? We laughed, we drank, we danced the night away, it was wonderful. Partying till morning, in the glare of the sun.

EmberwoodPuzzle.ArmadylStatue.ShadyGhost.src: I shouldn't be here. I deserve to move on! I was there, sure, when the bodies piled up, but I had nothing to do with it. It was a sunny day, the light was in my eyes and there were rabbits everywhere and I just thought, why not? You know? There's good eating on one of those.

EmberwoodPuzzle.ArmadylStatue.Suspicious.src: I think it was the laughing that came first. Loud and obnoxious, a guffawing cackle that we heard over the screaming. They thought it was funny, as they tore the city apart. Laughing as they went.

Death.QuestNotStarted.Intro.5.src: I would start by seeking out an old friend of yours, young Cathan. He's been doing some work for me, investigating the site of some necromantic ritual or other. Before you do that, though, you'll need to get into Fellhollow. A colleague of mine, Postie Pete, can help you with that.

EmberwoodPuzzle.ArmadylStatue.Snickering.src: I'd just been wandering over by the party room, the sound of balloons popping is soothing, you know? I had my bow out, because, well, I thought I could shoot a couple of them that floated away. Balloons, obviously.

Cathan.StandingStones.Intro.5.src: I'm not exactly knowledgeable about curses, but I can feel a strange sort of necromantic power in the air. It mostly focuses over the big tower over there, like a ward keeping us out, but it also converges here by these stones. Something odd about them. Worth a look?

Cathan.PostQuest.3.src: I've spotted this great keep up on the mountains. Feels like there might be someone alive there. What do you say? Meet you there? One last great adventure or something like that?

Cathan.StandingStones.NotFoundStones.2.src: If I wasn't a misty cloud of regret in a vaguely human shape, I'd try and work out what those stones are pointing to, and then deal with whatever's there.

Death.ImaruSlain.NoHead.src: If you bring me her head, then I'll turn it into something useful. Grim, yes, but one must have something to put in the filing cabinet.

Death.FirstTimeTalkingAboutStore.StoreEx.src: If you come across any of these soul fragments, please bring them to me and I will happily exchange them for special items you cannot get anywhere else. Here, let me show you some of the items available to you.

Death.AskAbout.WitherRot.1.src: Imagine, for a moment, that your soul is on a string and that string gets snagged round a tree. As your body walks, the essence that is you gets pulled further and further away.

Death.ImaruSlain.1.src: Imaru the devourer is dead. Good! She was a potential problem that I did not want to have to deal with. You've done well, adventurer, better than the last few I sent anyway.

Death.AskAbout.WitherRot.6.src: In short, it's a bad thing. Probably want to deal with it quickly.

Death.AskAbout.Underworld.2.src: In the Underworld, a great river, the river Noumenon, carries souls down to mighty gates that lead to what lies beyond. What happens next is a mystery, even to me.

EmberwoodPuzzle.ArmadylStatue.MainStatue.src: Incorrect. An arbiter must not be so blind to the crimes committed. Speak to the spirits again to learn the true crime committed.
Incorrect. An arbiter must not be so blind to the crimes committed. Speak to the spirits again to learn the true crime committed.
Indeed, a brutal and terrible crime. Many lives lost in an instant, their families deprived of their loved ones. Tell me, why was such an act committed?

SaradominSymbolDescription.src: It looks as if it is meant to sit on top of something.

EmberwoodPuzzle.ArmadylStatue.Snickering.src: It was a lovely house party, really it was. But, the weather was cold and grey, and I just wanted to go for a walk, you know? So that's why I was there, in the park, when the trouble started.

Death.AskAbout.Death.5.src: It's a lonely old job, sometimes, and the paperwork will drive you to madness. But, I have Muncher to help with the lonliness, and all the time in the world to make a decent headstart on the paperwork.

EmberwoodPuzzle.GateArmadylStatue.Inacti.src: Justice must be maintained, even in times of great strife. Seek the wisdom of Armadyl on a nearby lake, where three spirits await judgement.  Obtain the blessings of all the gods to destroy the barrier.

EmberwoodPuzzle.ArmadylStatue.MainStatue.src: Justice must prevail, for the barrier to rise. Such is the will of Armadyl. Long ago a terrible act was committed. What was the crime? Who is responsible and why did they do it? Name these and unlock the blessing of Armadyl.

PostiePete.QuestComplete.src: Nice work in Fellhollow! You're really a step a-head of the mainland adventurers. Now that things have calmed down a bit, I've got decades worth of letters to deliver. So I'm just gonna rest here a bit before I start.

Death.QuestNotStarted.RunPastDeath.src: No. You can't outrun death, no matter how hard you try. Come back and speak to me, or you're not going to get very far.

Death.AllSealsObtained.1.src: Now that you're borrowing the power of her curse, Imaru is finally vulnerable. She's had centuries of souls to feast on, and she's still one of Kuldra's draconic generals, so she won't go down easily. Make sure you're prepared.

Cathan.ThirdSealObtained.3.src: Now that you've got yourself nice and cursed, you can breach the tower right? Time to take on Imaru and destroy her once and for all! I wish I could join you, but I'll be there in spirit. Well... not literally, cos she eats those, but you know what I mean.

WoM.AshiensWatchLocation.IntroCompletedD.src: Now then, an adventurer's work is never finished. Trust me, I know.

WoM.DragonSlayerLocation.GoToAshiensWatc.src: Now then, an adventurer's work is never finished. Trust me, I know. There's a strange door to the north, just past Ashien's Watch and it's sending chills down my spine. Meet me there, we'll talk more.

Death.OptionalChoices.Generic.src: Now then, what do you need?

Death.ImaruSlain.HasHead.HasSpace.2.src: Now, I have an enormously unpleasant cleanup to do. So you'll forgive me if I get back to work.

Death.FirstTimeTalkingAboutStore.StoreEx.src: Now, before you go anywhere, there's something I'd like to discuss. Soul fragments. These little stones are of no use to you, but very useful to me. They contain the last traces of the poor lost souls of Fellhollow, and I would like to help them move on.

Cathan.StandingStones.Intro.4.src: Now, normally I'd say you should go and give her hell, but get this - she's not just a dragon, she's a CURSED dragon! And this curse, it makes her bigger, nastier and generally unstoppable. Someone did some proper dark magic here to get that going, but if you're going to take this dragon out, you need to deal with that somehow.

WoM.AshiensWatchLocation.IntroCompletedD.src: Obviously, I'm not going to open it, so I'm giving the words to you. You need to go up to the door and say "Mors, introitum quaero!" and it should let you in.

PostiePete.GoSeeDeath.Rifted.src: Oh dear, look at you running a-head of yourself. You're all soul rifted, and that's gonna get painful quick. You should go speak to Death before you do yourself a mischief.

PostiePete.QuestInProgress.SoulRifted.src: Oh dear, looking a bit peaky there. You should find yourself a rejuvination pool before Imaru spots you. Trust me.

Death.QuestNotStarted.Intro.1.src: Oh, cease your cowering, you're not dead. You still have at least twenty minutes before I reap your soul.

PostiePete.GoSeeDeath.NotRifted.src: Oh, ho, ho. Getting waay a-head of yourself here. I think you should go speak to tall, dark and spooky back there, huh?

Death.AskAbout.Death.2.src: Or, you can call me Harold, though few ever do. I was once like you, just a normal man, living a normal life -- a farmer, I think, though it's difficult to remember so long ago.

Cathan.StandingStones.FoundStones.src: Pieces of Imaru's curse, just up for grabs? Feels like someone's laid a trap for big, mean and scaly. I'll leave it to you to go and collect them, I don't think I'm going to do much against a dragon that eats wandering souls.

QuestDesc.src: Put an end to the horror of Fellhollow, by defeating Imaru, the soul-devourer.

Seal.Vault.NotActivated.1.src: Rage unlike any other, fueled by grief and terrible loss, wraps around your heart like a vice, before its grip finally relents as you take a piece of the curse for yourself.

Objective.RemoveSoulRift.src: Remove the Soul Rift at a Purification Pool.

EmberwoodPuzzle.GateSaradominStatue.Inac.src: Saradomin shields this village from the relentless dead. Seek his power on high, surrounded by a ring of water. Obtain the blessings of all the gods to destroy the barrier.

PostiePete.Intro.3.src: See that horrible red stuff over there? I know it looks nasty, I certainly wouldn't have the stomach for it, but you're going to need to dip your toes in for a minute or two to get nice and Soulrifted. That'll let you see things you living types never get to see.

WoM.AshiensWatchLocation.IntroCompletedD.src: See this creepy little passageway? There's a door at the bottom wreathed in magic, and the spooky stuff at that -- necromancy. I've been studying it for a while and I've learned the words to allow access.

EmberwoodPuzzle.ArmadylStatue.ShadyGhost.src: So many dead. Falador lined with bodies. But, it wasn't me, honest. I had nothing to do with it. I was just hunting rabbits.

So, I took a shot, even though the glare made it hard to see and, well, next thing I know there's screaming. I ran, I admit it. I ran from the city gate, all the way to the party room. I figured music and revelry would keep me safe, right?

PostiePete.Soulrifted.3.src: So, if I were you -- and I had feet -- I'd get my skates on and make a beeline straight for a purification pool. You can't miss them, Death's made them extra glowy, just for you!

Cathan.StandingStones.NotFoundStones.1.src: So, you think those stones mean something? Feels like they're pointing to something important. There's a lot of necromantic magic whizzing around here, and these things seem to be the focus of it all.

Objective.VisitWoM.src: Speak to the Wise Old Man near Ashien's Watch.

EmberwoodPuzzle.ArmadylStatue.MainStatue.src: Speak to the ghosts to learn their take on the events. Look for the discrepancies and the emotions at play, the guilty often trap themselves with their own lies.

PostiePete.Intro.2.src: Still, if you're determined to head on through, you'll need to shed a few pounds. You need to get Soulrifted, my friend. Need to get that spirit of yours dragged a little into the world of the dead. It's the only way to get through this here gate.

Death.AskAbout.Death.6.src: Still, when Gielinor itself dies and I can retire, I suspect there will still be more forms to fill in than there are stars in the skies. Only two things in life are guaranteed, death and paperwork... and the former is debatable.

FellhollowEntrance.DefaultInteraction.src: Strange magic radiates off the door. It seems like it requires a phrase of some kind to access.

PostiePete.FailedFiveTimes.src: Struggling a bit, I take it? I get it, I can be such a numb-skull sometimes. Here, let me help you out. You need to get Soulrifted, which means you need to go and stand in that horrible red nastiness over there until you can see dead-people-things...like the door outta here.

EmberwoodPuzzle.ArmadylStatue.Suspicious.src: Sure, in the chaos, I stole a couple of gemstones someone left as they ran. But, i mean, come on, it was a drop party after all! Fair game. I shouldn't have to suffer because of that.

Death.AskAbout.WitherRot.5.src: That is the curse that afflicts Fellhollow. Raising the dead as mindless creatures, and forcing the souls to wander the world unable to pass on. Doomed to lose themselves and go mad from the lonely horror of it all.

Cathan.ThirdSealObtained.1.src: That's all of the seals. Wow, you're really good at this. I thought I was cut out to be an adventurer, but compared to you I'm a joke.

Death.AskAbout.Underworld.3.src: The Menaphite god Icthlarin, guards souls as they pass through the gate. Time was that Amascut would offer some souls rebirth, but things have been... tricky, on that front for a while.

OneSealRemains.src: The curse echoes within your soul. One curse shard remains.

ShatteredTower.NotGotSeals.src: The door refuses to open. Powerful necromantic seals bar your entry. You will need the full power of Imaru's curse to break through them.

EmberwoodPuzzle.GuthixStatue.DragonStill.src: The dragon's power prevents you from using this.

StandingStone.Vault.src: The dragonkin knew cruelty well, creating creatures whose lives were songs of suffering. Beneath the remains of Imaru's lover, behind a waterfall tainted by her sorrow, lies an ancient structure. Within it I hid a piece of the curse, guarded by the cruel masters that chained her.

Death.AskAbout.Fellhollow.4.src: The land is cursed and dangerous. The perfect place for an adventurer like yourself to cut their teeth, no?

EmberwoodPuzzle.GateGuthuxStatue.Inactiv.src: The lord of balance leaves his blessing in a harmonious circle, guarded by a dread beast. Obtain the blessings of all the gods to destroy the barrier.

EmberwoodPuzzle.GateZamorakStatue.Inacti.src: The power of chaos wards this village form harm. Hail Zamorak! Seek his altar near by, where the suffering is strongest. Obtain the blessings of all the gods to destroy the barrier.

EmberwoodPuzzle.GuthixStatue.DragonDefea.src: The shrine hums with magical power, weakening the barrier around Emberwood Village.

EmberwoodPuzzle.ZamorakStatue.Active.src: The shrine hums with magical power, weakening the barrier around Emberwood Village.

EmberwoodPuzzle.SaradominStatue.MainStat.src: The shrine hums with magical power, weakening the barrier enchantment around Emberwood village.

EmberwoodPuzzle.ArmadylStatue.MainStatue.src: The shrine hums with magical power, weakening the barrier.

EmberwoodPuzzle.SaradominStatue.MainStat.src: The shrine is damaged, a piece missing. Until it is repaired the magic cannot flow to the village barrier.

EmberwoodPuzzle.InactiveStatue.src: The statue no longer maintains the barrier to the village.

WoM.AshiensWatchLocation.NotDoneDragonSl.src: The thing that really interests me though is down this little passageway. There's a door, and it's sealed by magic. Strange stuff too, old and powerful. It'll take me some time to work it out.

Death.AskAbout.Fellhollow.1.src: The waters of the River Noumenon flow into this region, and to be clear they shouldn't. Something about this place has caused damage enough to the Underworld to harm the world of the living as well.

PlayerChoice.ArmadylPuzzle.Suspect.Shady.src: There are no rabbits in Falador.

Cathan.StandingStones.Intro.2.src: There are some lingering ghostly echoes around the place, and I got talking to them. Seems like there was this big friendly dragon called Imaru, who turned somewhat unfriendly after being killed by some other, bigger, less-friendly dragon. Now she's stuck in the afterlife, eating any unfortunate souls that come her way.

Death.AskAbout.Underworld.1.src: There is a life after death, that's one great mystery answered for you - you're welcome. When a person dies I cut the cord connecting their soul to their body and allow them to pass into the Underworld.

StandingStone.Emberwood.src: There was a village once, west of the tower, that I made my home. The people lived together, peacefully, happily, under the guardianship of dragons. Imaru's grief and rage has made it a prison, all joy turned to fear. I placed a piece of the curse within its heart, an anchor made of suffering.

Cathan.StandingStones.NotFoundStones.Fai.src: There's something strange about these stones, they're a focus point for a whole load of necromantic energy. Maybe try reading them?

PlayerChoice.ArmadylPuzzle.Suspect.Snick.src: They found it too funny. Matching the motive.
They have a very annoying laugh.

PlayerChoice.ArmadylPuzzle.Suspect.Suspi.src: They were drunk, but their story was too detailed.

Death.AskAbout.Fellhollow.3.src: This isn't just people either. Animals, even the plants, have had some of their vitality drawn out of them. Even the water is tainted with the essence of the river Noumenon -- meaning you need to be careful trying to drink it.

Death.FoundStones.3.src: Those wandering dead are stuck. Trapped. Unable to move on whilst Imaru still guards the region. Furthermore, you cannot just destroy Imaru, because she is empowered by a foolish necromantic curse.

WoM.AshiensWatchLocation.NotDoneDragonSl.src: Thought I'd do some exploring, it gets boring sitting in a ruined little village all the time... so I found a new ruined area, but this time with angry dog-people. Anyway, they leave me alone, I leave them alone.

PlayerChoice.ArmadylPuzzle.Motive.Wrong..src: To spread fear among the population.

StandingStone.SilverthornKeep.src: To the east stands a fortress that once housed the Wild Knights, brave soldiers of Guthix. They fought bravely against the endless hordes of the dead, but, like all things, fell in the end. I have left a shard of the curse there, guarded by their last living protector.

Cathan.SecondSealObtained.1.src: Two down, one to go. You've really got the hang of this adventurer gig. I'm kinda jealous, I'd always wanted to be one of the heroic types. Great adventures, derring-dos and all that.

UnleashCurse.src: Unleash the curse, destroying the fragments, and face Imaru?

EmberwoodPuzzle.ArmadylStatue.Suspicious.src: We thought we might end celebrations at the Party Room, you know? Balloons, prizes, everyone having the time of their lives? Sure, we were a bit drunk, but who wouldn't be after an all night rager?

Death.QuestNotStarted.Intro.3.src: Welcome to Fellhollow. The whole region is infected with a terrible withering. Some dread curse that untethers the soul and drags it to the river Noumenon without ever sailing upon it, preventing the dead from moving on. This cannot stand.

WoM.AshiensWatchLocation.IntroCompletedD.src: Well? Go on, get! I don't have all day to hold your hand. There's something weird and sinister, go poke it with a stick like you always do!

Death.OptionalChoice.Hub.src: What would you like to know?

EmberwoodPuzzle.ArmadylStatue.Snickering.src: What? Oh, come on, you'd have been laughing too. Balloons exploding as people fell over them running, you can't not laugh at that? It was all "Aaargh *POP* Noooo! *POP* My precious spleen!" how is that not funny?

Death.AskAbout.Fellhollow.2.src: Whatever is happening prevents souls from reaching the Afterlife. More than that, it seems to prevent my ability to reap them. They are all off my list, and that's just not proper.

Death.AllSealsObtained.2.src: When she's slain, bring me her head. Gruesome, I know, but I will need it to give her spirit peace at least. Also it helps with the paperwork.

EmberwoodPuzzle.ArmadylStatue.ShadyGhost.src: When the balloons started popping, I just assumed it was another drop party, you know? I figured there was always a chance I could get something from one, like a party hat or something. But they weren't popping because of parties, they were popping because the arrows went flying.

PostiePete.QuestInProgress.src: Yeah, Fellhollow's a bit of a nightmare, isn't it? You're absolutely doomed mate. Haha, just ribbing you! I'm sure you've got this all under control.

Death.FoundStones.2.src: Yes, I already knew, but, as per my writing group, I feel showing is often better than telling. You've now seen the state of Fellhollow for yourself, it's not a good sight I'm sure you'll agree.

EmberwoodPuzzle.ArmadylStatue.MainStatue.src: Yes, the guilty often miss the smaller details as they try to pretend their innocence. This spirit was responsible for the destruction and will pay the price in the afterlife.

Yes. Imagine, an act of such violence, such tragedy and loss. Families ruined. Destinies upended. Futures shattered. All because someone found it amusing. As though the lives of others carry no more weight than an ant beneath ones boot. But, tell me, who committed the crime?

Yes. Sometimes the guilty lack shame, or remorse, unable to keep their strange sense of pride hidden. To them, this massacre was an amusement, a bit of a laugh. To others, it was the worst day of their lives... or their last.

Death.AskAbout.WitherRot.4.src: Yet, it is not your time and you did not pass naturally. Your body, while dead, still wanders because it is now driven not by your will, but by instinct, hunger and a need to live again.

Death.AskAbout.WitherRot.3.src: Yet, with each step, you lose more and more of that grasp on life. Your soul is tugged further and further from your body until finally... SNAP! Your tether breaks and your soul is lost to the twilight.

Seal.Activated.1.src: You already have this shard of the curse, there is nothing more to do here .

EmberwoodPuzzle.SaradominStatue.HeadPiec.src: You collect the broken statue piece.

PostiePete.Soulrifted.2.src: You don't want to stay soul rifted for too long. As time goes on you'll attract the hungry dead to you, eventually luring Imaru herself and... well... that won't end well for you.

TwoSealsRemain.src: You feel the curse begin to build within you. Two shards still remain.

EmberwoodPuzzle.SaradominStatue.HeadPiec.src: You have no room in your inventory to pick up the statue piece.

EmberwoodPuzzle.ZamorakStatue.Inactive.src: You offer a prayer to the shrine and it hums with magical energy. The barrier around the village weakens.

EmberwoodPuzzle.GuthixStatue.DragonDefea.src: You offer a prayer to the shrine, and it hums with magical power. The barrier around Emberwood village weakens as a result.

EmberwoodPuzzle.SaradominStatue.MainStat.src: You repair the broken shrine. Magic thrums into life, feeding energy back to the village barrier.

Death.AskAbout.WitherRot.2.src: You start to see the world as a spirit would. As everything around you drains of life, colour and vibrancy, you see the hidden things that lie beneath the glamour of living.

PostiePete.Intro.4.src: You'll want to find a Purification Pool, once you've found your way past that wall. There's one down the path outta here, I think, but I'm getting a-head of myself there. Get to it quick, the longer you're soul rifted, the more likely *she* is to spot you, and the worse things will get. If that dragon finds you, you're dead, no two ways about it.

WoM.DragonSlayerLocation.Generic.src: You've dealt with the problem for now, but who knows what danger waits around the corner? If I were you, I'd get yourself ready for whatever horribleness is coming next.

FinalSeal.src: Your soul resonates with Imaru's grief. You are ready to bring the fight to her.

DifficultySetting.AllSkillsMaxed.Descrip.src: Access to all Skill Tree Spells, Perks and Unlocks

DifficultySetting.FriendlyFire.Descripti.src: Allow or prevent players from damaging each other

DifficultySetting.ResetLastCompletedXPLe.src: Any XP you had between achieved Skill Levels is lost upon death

DifficultySetting.AllCraftingRecipesUnlo.src: Full access to all Crafting recipes

DifficultySetting.AllBuildingPiecesUnloc.src: Full access to the building catalogue

DifficultySetting.MaxNumberOfGravestones.src: How many active Gravestones you can have active in the world at a given time

DifficultySetting.MajorWorldEventFrequen.src: How often Major World Events will occur

DifficultySetting.MinorWorldEventFrequen.src: How often Minor World Events will occur

DifficultySetting.MaxNumberOfGravestones.src: Max Number Of Gravestones Per Player

Dowdun_L3_Text.src:
A warning, if you wish to restore the portals here. 

Don't. 

But I know it won't stop you. History is made by those who disregard warnings.

The portals are blocked, sealed on the other side. There are a number, strewn across the Reach. Find them and unclog them to return here. The magic of the Dreaming Stone will do the rest.

For my conscience, at least prepare for what follows. There will be blood, a shattering of dreams, and the burning stare of the sun. Consider yourself twice-warned.

Dowdun_L6_Text.src:
Am I the only one that works around here? Because it seems like I am. Each day, I log the incoming supplies and assign where they’ll go in the keep; and each day, everyone forgets that I need money to secure them.

Instead, they bicker and fight among themselves like pups.

We were great once, weren’t we? The mighty Children of Shadows, reborn as Zamorak’s knights of black! We were magi with the power to call a legion of demons to serve at our command.

Now, I have to explain to the cook why we’ve got three cabbages between us, and find a way to make it last a week.

I would leave, if the Shadows would let me. But they tell me I have work to do, and must stay here to keep it going. I try to ignore them as best I can, but they can be so very cruel.

Dowdun_L14_DisplayName.src: An Acolyte's Guide to Demon Handling

Dowdun_L2_Text.src:
Apprentice - a word, if you will.

I see that you are eager to progress. That's good. Eagerness will get you far under the gaze of Zamorak. Eagerness needs two partners, however. Power and knowledge. 

Power is easy. It is everywhere, as long as you take off the blindfold of morality. Power does not bring corruption, but freedom. Only with power - true power - can we rise to the heights that we deserve to reach.

But knowledge, that is a harder path. That journey starts here, in the books of the library.  

First, build a THRONE, a place to sit in cold detachment. Then construct an unbreakable PHILOSOPHY, one that describes you. On that structure weave SORCERY, the light that guides. Only then, finally, can you CONQUER all.

Dowdun_L13_Text.src:
Can't focus in my quarters. There's three of us in there. Too crowded. I can string thoughts together here. Not many - a few gems on a necklace.

We are afflicted by not one, but two diseases. They tussle, fighting. A cure needs to kill them both. 

I thought, maybe, if I poison one - the weaker one - then the other will eat it. Wither. Die. 

I think I know where the weak one resides. I hear it whisper in my left ear. I will dropper the toxin there. Let it feed. Yum. Let the toxin spread.

Shush! The chicken and the master come again. I must look busy.

Busy busy busy busy busy.

Dowdun_L8_Text.src:
Deny what is written.
Dispute that you denied it. 
Sympathise with the confused.
Slit them as they leave.
Mourn their death.
Blame their brethren.
Make a deal with the accused.
Take what is offered.
Give nothing back.
Deny what is written.

Repeto.

Dowdun_L1_Text.src:
Do not go to Dowdun Reach, traveller. Turn back now while you can. Even if you are faithful to the Dark Lord - no, especially if you are faithful - do not risk the madness within these walls, lest it condemn you and your faith to ruin.

We had thought it nonsense that the mages here would delve into the darker magics. They were charlatans. Harmless magicians. They were meant to pull rabbits from hats and flowers from their sleeves. Instead, they have learned more sinister arts, older and more wicked than anything we could imagine.

Saradomin has cursed them, I am sure of it. A malady suitable for their blasphemy. They seem consumed with madness, with hatred; a bestial rage that burns away all sense or reason.

Do not go to Dowdun Reach, traveller. Only horror awaits you there.

Dowdun_L17_Text.src:
Dowdun Reach isn’t just the home of warriors. It is the birthplace of legends. Those who refused to follow the limited, vapid doctrines of the Saradominist faith and come to understand that freedom itself is a virtue worth fighting for.

Within these halls rest the pathbuilders and wayfinders for a new world order. One born of personal choice and freedom, rather than tyranny and oppression. They are not interred in nearby graves, nor scattered as ashes across the firmament. No, they rest within these very walls, each statue housing what is left of their earthly forms.

There is Isla, known as the Blood Witch, or the Lady of Screams. She was the first to prise the secrets of runecrafting from the blue robed wizards, passing that knowledge on to our own mages so that we might tear open the veil of reality and make bargains with the infernal realm.

Gregor Volrath, the Mountain Lion, defended these mountains in the days before the keep was tall enough to defend itself. The mithril lined crags were too tempting for the neighbouring villagers and Gregor held them back with hammer and shield.

Each statue houses a legacy. Each stone stores a soul. Each footstep that echoes through these walls is a reminder of the great heroes that walked here before.

Dowdun_L15_Text.src:
Frends of da rebel lotion, it is time to drop da shackles of Lord Rasmo-smell and All-thick.

Dey promised us gold an food and travel back home, to da Felldips. But have dey provided?

NO. Dey have not provided. We only have food scraps which WE have to cooks!

I call on us all to rise up, like bread.

Sneeze at da means of production! Stir snot in da soup. Cough gunge on da bedcovas.

Take arms against da oh-pressers! Their pressing time is OVA!

We meet in da shed near da waterfall at sunny down time.

Dowdun_L14_Text.src:
I'm out of here - being transferred to the Library. These are my handover notes. Don't worry, you'll get the hang of demon-handling in no time.

1. 'Demon-handling' is a turn of phrase. Avoid touching 'em.

2. Marrentil round the nostrils helps with the sulphur smell.

3. Demons don't like it if you copy their gruff voices.

4. While they may not cover up their nethers, you would be wise not to stare.

5. Awfunctious has learned to copy Alric's voice. Alric'll only talk to you if he wants a cup of tea.

6. Alric likes white tea, no sugar. 

7. Always look at what you're signing. Requisition forms have a habit of being swapped for demon pacts.

8. You can tell it's a demon pact because it reeks of sulphur - even the marrentil won't stop it.

9. When locking up, make sure to test your binding spells. Festilius has a habit of finding flaws and unwinding them. 

10. If you lose Festilius, he'll be in the chicken coop.

Dowdun_L12_Text.src:
If I were to weigh Rasmodel, he would have one ounce of value. That ounce is his leadership, or, more specifically, what I have learned from it. 

He has taught me that when you make a mistake, you do not run from it. Instead, you claim it was your intention all along. If a scouting party is killed, they were traitors that you sent on a suicide mission. If the sewers flood and illness spreads, you were building the troops' immunity. Admit nothing, own everything.

My infernal gateway is no longer a gateway. The tens of thousands of demon souls are no longer powering it. It seems that they have been quietly bleeding into the fortress itself. Each brick now whispers with the avernic. They are in the walls. Demons now summon themselves, at their own whims, from any room.

I do not run from this. It was my intention. I claim it.

This is what I tell my magi: there is no corner of Dowdun Reach that is safe from us now. If you connive against us magi, a demon may be listening. If you walk without a partner, an avernic may digest you. This is the rule of the keep now. 

All that remains is to find the voice beneath the voices. I know it is there - I can hear it. Once it is identified, I will claim it, too.

Dowdun_L5_Text.src:
Is it regret or hubris that banishes my dreams each night? I cannot remember the last time I dreamed a dream of my own, and not that of… the other.

Perhaps it is the foolishness of an old man, clinging to the sharpness of his youth. The passage of time curses me with a dullness that is not my own. My flesh feels alien to me, as if I am a skin worn by something else. My insides writhe and burn like snakes of fire. Even touch feels strange to me, as if there were layers of strange cloth between me and the world.

Is this age? Foolishness? Or something worse?

Our demons have said nothing for some time. The voices tell me to ignore it, that I am overthinking things and just need to try to sleep. Yet the others whisper threats and curses from the corners of the room, the cracks in the ceiling, wishing me naught but harm.

I have made this place better, stronger, more powerful. It was by my hand that we brought the demons through. They should bow in adoration of my power, yet they laugh at me from behind the curtains and pretend they’re not really there.

All will come to respect me.

All will come to despise me.

The whispers are wrong: I am not mad.

The whispers are right.

Dowdun_L16_Text.src:
Lord Alric, please find the group's assessment of the necroseismic event that the locals call 'The Withering'.

The people of Fellhollow are not well-equipped for the contamination. They have grown soft through their freedoms, and have mostly resorted to panic. We are the only ones studying and measuring the effects.

It is our belief that the subcontinent of Fellhollow will be entirely contaminated in the next two weeks. It spreads at a significant rate, roughly a hectare a day, and is only slowed or halted by mountains and bodies of water.

By our calculations, the size and breadth of the Dowdun Mountains should protect us. We would like to emphasise 'should' here: there is a risk that waterways and crevices in the rock may lead to intrusions. We mean intrusions in the broadest sense: the effects of the Withering, necromantic incursions and unwanted refugees.

It is our recommendation that all efforts are made to seal Dowdun Reach. We should be focused on removing these opportunities for intrusion. All connecting pathways to the subcontinent of Fellhollow should be severed.

We should also post knights to the crypt. It will be our canary in the mineshaft. If the dead rise there, we will know that the Withering has breached.

Dowdun_L4_Text.src:
Oh, how this wretched thing has brought calamity to this sacred place. We were founded on the glorious tenets of Zamorak, not the whispering of some crystal stolen from the desert. Yet, look how they bandy around it, as though it were the most marvellous thing.

I will not have it.

Vulketra and his deranged fanatics need this stone for their schemes; need its power to turn against my forces. They need its strength to bind the demons to their wills and slaughter me and mine.

I shall not give them the satisfaction.

The stone will be destroyed. I will see to it. I am done with its whispering and the madness it inspires in my once glorious fraternity. It shall fall to the edge of my blade and I will see it shatter to dust.

I will laugh as they mourn its end.

Dowdun_L11_Text.src:
The thought came to me as I slept. Should I worry that my genius rises when I am defenceless? Rasmodel would do much with that information.

You see, nothing enthralls a demon more than other demons. They despise and bicker, drawn into a game of spite.  It may seem like repulsion, but in truth they are drawn to one another. They live - should you call it living - to be in each other's company.

Knowing this to be true, I think on my skills of possession. I am still mastering the art, but there have been breakthroughs. I am able to siphon a soul from the living and store it in the inanimate, just for a moment. My goblet gained the soul of a slave (and filled with tears! A delightful discovery). My mirror reflected only my last, sycophantic apprentice, for a time, at least.

If I could bottle and transpose the soul of a demon - or whatever makeshift thing they have as a soul - could I infuse a demonic gateway? My theory, my hope, is that the gateway would enthrall others of their kind. They would be drawn, consciously or subconsciously, in numbers that we could barely contain. A portal like that would need an incredible number of demonic souls to keep powered, but, in that respect, I am not worried. The infernal gate would supply itself.

DreamingStone_1_4_Shards.src: ... I am... I remember... broken... lost...

WoM_GatekeeperDoorOpen_TitanNotDefeated_.src: A Black Knight Titan... made from the fusion of demonic sorcery, chthonian nonsense and dragonkin mad science...

DreamingStone_Optional_Dialogue_3_3_Most.src: A fragment of myself drives him, separate from the mind that speaks to you now. In a strange way, like the knights of this place, I am in a civil war of myself.

DreamingStone_Optional_Dialogue_2_1_Some.src: A grand project of cooperation, crafted by a society of paranoid narcissists.

DreamingStone_Optional_Dialogue_3_2_Most.src: A great giant of a man, a titan one might say. Flesh twisted, mind shattered, but far more deadly than before.

WoM_Optional_Dialogue1_2.src: A group of human settlers moved here from Fellhollow some time before... well... before it all turned spooky and weird. They called themselves the Children of Shadows, because everyone wants to be edgy.

Zamorakian_Mage_GiveContainer_1.src: A memory in glass. A smile in kaleidoscopic fragments. Abraxus always was an artist at heart.

DoorToDowdun_NotFinishedWitheringH.src: A powerful force holds this door shut. A chill runs down your spine reminding you that Death has a job for you and it's a good idea not to forget about it.

Goblin_Chef_NotSpokenTo_1.src: Ah, delightful, a human not driven mad by the strange afflictions of this place. Delighted, delighted to meet you, truly.

Goblin_Chef_HaveRecipe_NoSandwich.src: Ah, my olfactory processes are on overdrive. Please, if you could deliver 5 maple sap to me, why it would be the most exquisite thing!

Wom_Optional_Dialogue4_1.src: Ah, the god of chaos, or rebellion if you're a more generous sort. He was once one of the Mahjarrat, a cruel race of shapeshifting sorcerers from the world of Freneskae.

Goblin_Chef_NotSpokenTo_2.src: Ah, yes, forgive my loquaciousness, you do seem frightfully busy. I deduce from your bearing that you require the shards of the Dreaming Stone.

Goblin_Chef_SpokenTo_GotMeal_1.src: Ah, yes, there it is. The sweet smell of succulent maple, pooled into a delicate ambrosia. Yes, this is worth losing my intellect for. May I?

WoM_NotSpokenTo_1.src: Ah, you're here, good. Looks like you had an easier time getting here than we did. Troublesome people here, had to give a few of them quite a wallop.

Doric_SpokenTo_DoorUnlocked.src: An ancient dragonkin brain in a rock, eh? Weird choice, but to each their own I guess. Well, the barrier's down now, but there's something big and dangerous beyond. Your area I think.

Library_Puzzle_Door_NoEntry.src: An ancient spell, enforced by some mechanism, prevents further access. You will need to find some way to unlock it.

Goblin_Chef_SpokenTo_GotMeal_4.src: And a supplementary reward: I always wanted to make a culinary delight from maple sap. The recipe will be no use to me now, so I pass it on to you.

WoM_GatekeeperDoorOpen_TitanNotDefeated_.src: Anyway, best go kill it before it gets loose and learns to sail back to the mainland to upend society. You know, like these things do.

Doric_NotSpokenTo_3.src: As far as I can tell, it's all connected to that great big stone over there. Seems like some sort of mystical thingamabob that powers it all.

Goblin_Chef_NotSpokenTo_3.src: As it happens, I have one with me – indeed it is the reason for a vocabulary far removed from the rest of my kin. Intellect is a terrible curse, however, and I would sooner remove it than keep it.

WoM_Optional_Dialogue3_1.src: Back on the mainland they'd be called the Kinshra, or Black Knights, but this is a different order. The Kinshra were formed sometime in the early fifth age, but it looks like these weirdos might be a bit older than that.

Cathan_PostQuest_1.src: Black Knight Titans and weird demonic curses. Ashenfall really doesn't seem to catch a break, does it?

Goblin_Fisherman_SpokenTo_HaveFish_3.src: Blerg! This is horrible and hard, like eating a rock... wait... that IS a rock! Why would fish be eating weird shiny rock? Blerg!

DreamingStone_Optional_Dialogue_1_3_Some.src: Bound into stone, so that I might escape some dread nightmare.

DreamingStone_Optional_Dialogue_3_4_Most.src: But the voice that speaks to you now, know that it is far more your ally than the beast beyond that barrier. At least a voice of crystal, you can trust.

Goblin_Chef_NotSpokenTo_4.src: But to do so, one must first savour a last meal while I have the capacity to do so. I have heard tell of a concoction so sweet, so crunchy, that it's like supping from a crystal cow's udder.

WoM_GatekeeperDoorOpen_TitanNotDefeated_.src: Do you know, I really miss the old days when things were normal. Just give me a dragon I can hit and call it day. None of this nightmare amalgam poppycock!

Crypt_Note_2.src: Eh, still my rock, they can't have it. I buried it somewhere they'd never think to look. In one of them big 'orrible graves of theirs.

Goblin_Fisherman_SpokenTo_HaveFish_4.src: Ere, you have it. I don't want it and I did promise you a reward. Don't say I ain't a goblin of me word!

Wom_Optional_Dialogue4_3.src: Ever since then Zamorak has set himself up as public enemy number one to any sapient being with half a braincell. He was one of the most active combatants in the God Wars and has continued to be the source of most problems ever since.

Goblin_Chef_SpokenTo_GotMeal_2.src: Exquisite! Truly a festival of flavour. How it tickles the tongue and delights the taste buds. Yes, yes, it's truly magnificent.

Library_Puzzle_Alrics_Notes_6.src: Finally, one must understand the purpose of power is not to control others, but to set oneself free. For what greater rebellion is there, than knowing you walk a path entirely of your own construction?

HutGoblin_PlayerChoice1.src: Give it or I'll hit you?

Library_Puzzle_Incorrect_Book_4.src: Glamorak – How a God's Fashion Can Incite Rebellion

Goblin_Fisherman_Quest_Complete_Repeat.src: Go away, you're scarin' off the fishes!

HutGoblin_NotSpokenToChef.src: Go away. I gots nothin for yas.

WoM_SpokenTo_NotDoric.src: Go speak to Doric, who's working on a solution. You can find him up in the nexus of this place. Though you might want to set up a basecamp here first.

Wom_Optional_Dialogue4_2.src: He came into power when he attempted to kill Zaros, in the Second Age, and stole as much of his power as he could. Zaros survived, sort of, but that's beside the point.

DreamingStone_TitanDefeated_UmS_Not_Out_.src: Here, have a little something as a bribe... I mean as a reward for not smashing me to pieces with a hammer.

Goblin_Chef_SpokenTo_GotMeal_3.src: Here, the shard, as promised. It has been a most delightful experience meeting you. I wish you well in all your adventures.

HutGoblin_NotSpokenToButSpokenToChef.src: Hrmm, you want the besterest recipe? Is secret. I won'ts tells ya nothin unless ya gives da password.

DreamingStone_AllShards_6.src: Hrmm... yes... well... your logic is sound. Perhaps I was a little overzealous in my bluster. Happens when you've been alone in the psyche of deranged Black Knights for too long.

DreamingStone_Optional_Dialogue_1_1_Some.src: I am a voice without a name, howling in the wilderness of memory.

DreamingStone_8_12_Shards_1.src: I am nearly whole...I walked the world, striding above it and overseeing everything... I was in a desert, sand beneath my feet and knowledge all around me...

DreamingStone_Optional_Dialogue_2_6_Most.src: I am unsure of what happened next, but the powers involved, the sheer magic at work... it had a terrible effect on this fortress. Those who dwelled within became twisted and strange. Life prolonged, but cursed with madness.

DreamingStone_AllShards_7.src: I blame the cthonian, horrible things. Anyway, you wanted that barrier lowered? it's no trouble, just let me fiddle a few things and... yep, there you go. No hard feelings eh?

DreamingStone_AllShards_PlayerChoice_1.src: I can just smash the crystal again.

WoM_NotSpokenTo_2.src: I had hoped to be hunting down the next dragon, trying to whittle down Kuldra's forces. But, wouldn't you know it, there's a whole ruddy keep in the way. Full of angry Zamorakians.

DreamingStone_AllShards_PlayerChoice_2.src: I have a hammer and I'm not afraid to use it.

Death_LinkToDowdun_2.src: I have sent young Cathan ahead to gather allies and investigate. You should find him to the east of Fellhollow.

Zamorakian_Mage_NotSpokenTo_4.src: I left my memories in a tranquil place, buried in the dirt. A garden where all the keep's creatures used to live. A dragon guards it now, though they know not what it is they protect.

WoM_Optional_Dialogue1_3.src: I think they wanted this to be some bastion of chaos. A sanctuary for Zamorak worshippers, where they could be as evil as they wanted – or pretended – to be, without upsetting the locals.

Goblin_Fisherman_NotSpokenTo_3.src: I want that fish! You sees it? The weird one, swimming around looking all strange and stuff. I bet it tastes delicious! Get me it and I'll give you something, fair trade, yeah?

Goblin_Fisherman_SpokenTo_NoFish_Repeat.src: I want that fish! You sees it? The weird one, swimming around looking all strange and stuff. I bet it tastes delicious! Get me it and I'll give you something, fair trade, yeah?

Cathan_DR_Entrance_2.src: I was gonna scout it out, spooky like, but I made the mistake of mentioning it to the Wise Old Man and... well... you know what he's like.

DreamingStone_Optional_Dialogue_1_2_Some.src: I was not always this. Once I walked these lands, towering above them.

Crypt_Note_4.src: I'm also a bit dizzy. I'll finish writing this and then maybe have a nap before I go and annoy the wife. She wants chicken for dinner and I don't want feathers in me teefs.

DreamingStone_Optional_Dialogue_2_5_Most.src: In time their rivalries turned into open conflict and that damned fool, Rasmodel, turned his blade upon myself and shattered the Dreaming Stone.

DreamingStone_AllShards_8.src: Just... be wary of Lord Rasmodel out there. Had a bit of a mishap when he smashed me to pieces. Now he's got some of me, some of a demon and a whole lot of anger issues. Best give him a swift death if you ask me.

Cathan_SpokenTo_2.src: Knowing him, he'll have set himself up somewhere important, like a nexus-type spot. You should head in and try to find him.

Library_Puzzle_Alrics_Notes_7.src: Learn these lessons, acolyte, and perhaps you will be worthy of my attention.

Doric_SpokenTo_NeedShards_Some.src: Looks like you're making some headway on those shards, keep it going. When it's repaired, hopefully that crystal will tell us how to get this barrier open.

DreamingStone_Optional_Dialogue_3_1_Most.src: Lord Rasmodel waits beyond that barrier, though he is not as he was. The energies he absorbed from my shattering, as well as that cthonian's parasitic cells have transformed him into something different.

DreamingStone_Optional_Dialogue_1_1_Most.src: Many of your lifetimes ago, I walked this realm, safe in the knowledge that there were none who could harm me. I was a scientist, a scholar, a genius dragged down by weaker minds.

DreamingStone_AllShards_2.src: Mwaha, mwahaha, mwahahahaha! Foolish little mammal, so simple in your thoughts that you cannot even grasp the depths of my genius. My name, it would rattle around in your tiny skull like the echoes within a cave.

Cathan_DR_Entrance_1.src: Never ends, does it? I've been investigating this place, seems to lead to some great fortress or other. It's blocking access to the Umbral Sands.

HutGoblin_CorrectPassword.src: Oh! You do know password. Ok, fair enough. Here, the recipe you was lookin' for.

DreamingStone_TitanDefeated_UmS_Not_Out_.src: Oh, you slew the titan? I am impressed. Really, you are quite capable, aren't you? When I find myself a new body and walk the world as a living god, you should come work for me. We'll do great things together!

DreamingStone_Optional_Dialogue_1_4_Most.src: One day, perhaps, I shall be freed from this prismatic prison, so that I might share my vast wisdom with the lesser beings of this world. Yet, I am not whole enough yet to do so, and more pieces of me remain.

Library_Puzzle_Alrics_Notes_5.src: One must have ambition also. For what is power without purpose? A liability. A chain. A noose. Power must be put to task, or it is mere languid possibility, that none should seek.

Library_Puzzle_Alrics_Notes_4.src: One must seek knowledge, striving towards a great comprehension of the true nature of the world.

Politeness, an alien concept to these foul beasts.
Still, they are better companions than the mould on the wall. It whispers strange new, alien recipes to me that are both toxic and delicious. I must listen closer, or I might just go mad.

Doric_NotSpokenTo_2.src: Problem being, we're stuck in this place until we can get this ruddy door open. It's barring our way to the desert, and nothing I try seems to fix it.

DreamingStone_Optional_Dialogue_2_2_Most.src: Some sought martial expertise, others delved into arcane knowledge and secrets that the rest of your kind foolishly abhor. It was these who found me buried in the sand of the desert, biding my time.

DreamingStone_Optional_Dialogue_2_3_Most.src: Soon distrust began to brew among the humans. I had some small part to play in that. Boredom is a poison no one can resist, and the antidote showed itself in small amusements. A whisper here, a secret there, and soon they turned on each other without mercy.

CathanJournal_VelgarsLair.src:
I was going to fight a dragon, until a dragonkin showed up. They were waiting in the shadows, as if they knew that I’d be there. At first, I drew my sword, ready to battle the creature. Yet there was an odd sort of gentleness to their stance, as though their attention was very far away.

We spoke, and I cannot quite put the conversation into words. I remember they never made eye contact, and their fingers flicked and tapped against themselves, as if remembering some strange sort of music. It was oddly calming and yet I’ve never felt more tense.

They warned me that Velgar isn’t the real danger, and they made it clear that my destiny was not to be his bane. There is someone else for that. Someone arriving soon, who will make the dragon pay for his crimes.

My destiny lies elsewhere. Working on the true danger – Queen Kuldra, the god-eater.

My new friend tells me that I have a part to play in her downfall, and, even though I have only just met them, I believe them – as if we have always known one another.

I leave now, heading deeper into this continent. If you find this, adventurer, then do one thing for me? Kick Velgar’s scaly arse.

<There is a crude drawing of a knight kicking a dragon’s behind. The dragon does not seem happy with this situation>

CathanJournal_Castle.src:
I’ve always wanted to be an explorer. To journey far from home, see sights no one has ever seen before. So, imagine my surprise when I get here and see Lumbridge, bloody, castle. Or its twin, anyway.

Its walls are crumbling, there’s no way to get inside. It’s surrounded by goblins and, for some reason, the fires burn blue. Yet the shape, the style, unforgettable. I bet Zanik has a theory about it. She always does.

The goblins were all dancing around praising the dragon. They were chanting “Velgar, Velgar, Velgar”, as if his name were a prayer. Like they were calling to him, trying to summon him down.

Their leaders all had these strange wooden horns that they blew as part of this chant. It’s clear that they’re emulating something. It’s obvious that this is a clue. I stole one of the pieces so I can get a sense of the shape, and I think I have an idea about where else to look. There were symbols on the horns that match the writing by that door in the swamp. 

I’ll take a look there next. The best secrets lie buried, after all.
