PlayerChoice.ItsALetterFromPostiePete.src: It's a letter from Postie Pete.

PostiePete.SpokenTo.GotThirdLetter.Deliv.src: Meet Parcel Pete, my far less handsome sibling and junior employee at the RPDT. They seem to have gotten it into their incredibly dense skull to try and "help"...

ParcelPete.IKnowYouHaveItResponse.src: No, you only THINK I have it. Now just go away and think about how bad you are at this!

ParcelPete.ItsALetterFromPostiePeteRespo.src: Not a clue who that is. Sounds like a right twerp though. Sorry, can't help you.

PostiePete.SpokenTo.GotSecondLetter.Deli.src: Oh dear... that's wool that is. Unspun wool of a ghostly sheep. If I know the dev... er... If I know the "gods" like I think I do, then there'll be some hidden around the place.

PostiePete.LinkFromFTUE.src: Oh! When you've done all of that, come back and see me, I've got something I could use a hand with. An actual hand, since I don't have them.

ParcelPete.OhYesYouDid.LoopedSolution.1.src: Oh, for Pete's sake! What are you, six? Urgh, fine! You win.

PostiePete.Intro.NotRightNowReply.1.src: Oh, not to worry. When you've got a moment just... head on back and see me.

Sheep.Simon.src: On closer inspection, this is actually a great big ball of spiderweb, filled with more spiders than your heart can handle. Best run away, very very fast!

Sheep.Steve.src: On closer inspection, this is just a cloud that's afraid of heights.

Sheep.Stuart.src: On closer inspection, this is two penguins in a sheep costume who shoo you away.

PostiePete.SpokenTo.GotSecondLetter.Deli.src: One of 'em will be right, the others will be some terrible joke that will fill you with well-deserved rage. I'm betting puns are in your future. I'm so sorry.

Quest.Desc.src: Postie Pete needs some help finding and delivering some stolen letters around Bleakfields Valley in Fellhollow.

PostBoxImaru.NoOthersLettersDelivered.src: Postie Pete suggested that something suspicious was waiting at the ruined house, outside the entrance to Fellhollow.

PostiePete.SpokenTo.GotSecondLetter.Deli.src: Second letter sorted? Not an idle bone in your body, is there! Now then, you found some spooky fluff? Let me take a look...

ParcelPete.QuestComplete.1.src: Sorry about messing you around there. I was just trying to help out my brother here, and, well, things got out of hand...

ParcelPete.QuestNotComplete.src: Sorry, bit distracted here trying to fill in this HR form. You should talk to old Postie here first.

PostiePete.SpokenTo.GotThirdLetter.Deliv.src: Thanks for delivering those letters. Here's the numbskull that caused the problem in the first place.

Sheep.Shaun.NotGotSpace.src: The ghostly sheep is chewing on a letter. You could take it easily from its mouth if you had any space free.

Sheep.Shaun.2.src: The ghostly sheep is chewing on a letter, you easily take it from its mouth.

Objective.SpeakToPete.src: Visit Postie Pete near the entrance to Fellhollow to begin searching for lost letters.

PlayerChoice.WaitINeverMentionedALetter.src: Wait – I never mentioned a letter!

SuspiciousSkeleton.ImLookingForLoveRespo.src: Well, don't look at me. You're not my type!

ParcelPete.QuestComplete.2.src: Well, as out of hand as you can get when you don't have hands. No hard feelings, eh?

SuspicousSkeleton.QuestStarted.ImLooking.src: Well, go look for something somewhere else!

Postbox.Letter1.Correct.src: When you post the letter, you find a strange leaf that appears to partially fade into the spirit world. It strongly reminds you of one of those spectral doors, perhaps there's one nearby?

Death.PostQuestLinkToPete.src: While you're around and if you have time to spare - which you do, I've checked my list - go and speak to Postie Pete. He has something he could use your help with.

ParcelPete.DoYouKnowAnyoneThatMightRespo.src: You could ask one of the zombies around here. They might have your letter. Not very talkative though.

SpectralDoorLetter.src: You find one of the missing letters!

Postbox.WrongOne.Generic.src: You have no letters for this address.

Postbox.Letter2.Correct.src: You notice a small patch of ghostly looking fluff, looks almost like un-spun wool. Perhaps you should seek out its former owner.

ParcelPete.AlrightWhatDidISayReponse.1.src: You said... err... something about dragons probably? I dunno. Urgh, fine! You win.

PlayerChoice.YouveGotTheLetterDontYou.src: You've got the letter, don't you?

GotAllIngrdients5.src: *A small greenish flame passes from the mirror and into the palm of your hand. It feels full of sorrow, rage and boundless grief.*

SeamstressHasQuest.src: A mote of light runs between yourself and the skeleton and she turns her skull to face you and opens her arms out wide, expectantly.

Spellbook.Intro.src: A mysterious spellbook, from Agatha's Magical Delivery Service.

SpectralSilverThreadDesc.src: A spooky silver thread. Used to repair mirrors from the inside.

IntroDialogue2.src: A... horrible necromancer trapped me in this mirror decades ago. Punishment for all my mistakes. I'm not saying I didn't deserve it, but it's been... well, an eternity, and I think I've served my time.

SpellBookDesc.src: An ancient book of spells by Agatha's mail-order magic service. "Guaranteed to put warts on your nose, or your money back!"

QuestComplete1.src: Brilliant stuff! I can get the spell going now. I should be out of here in... what... a week or so.

ReturnNoItemsDialogue4.src: Finally I need a copy of the spell itself. Using morse code and a very clever pigeon, I managed to order a copy from Agatha's mail-order magic -- but it got sent back to my shop, in my windmill in Emberwood village.

GotAllIngredients4.src: For each candle you light, you'll rekindle a memory that will help me reconnect myself to this world and pull myself back through. I'll give you a spark to reignite them, just a small piece of my soul, so the candles will ignite when you find them.

ReturnToMirrorNotAllCandlesLit3.src: For each candle you light, you'll rekindle a memory that will help me reconnect myself to this world and pull myself back through. I'll give you a spark to reignite them, just a small piece of my soul, so the candles will ignite when you find them.

ObjectiveOne.src: Gather dragon blood, spectral silver thread and a ritual spellbook, and bring them back to the mirror.

GotAllIngredients1.src: Great, that's all the bits I need! Thank you so much... I'll take those off your hands for now. Just press them to the glass. It's weird, I know, but it won't hurt.

QuestDescription.src: Help free a mysterious figure from their mirror prison.

QuestComplete4.src: Here, take this as a thank-you. Who knows, we might see each other on the other side sometime. Your side, I mean, not this one... That wasn't a threat, we're cool.

ReturnNoItemsDialogue1.src: I just need you to grab a few things, so I can get myself out of this mirror.

IntroDialogue4.1.src: I just need you to grab a few things. Dragon blood, which should be plentiful. A copy of the spell from my old shop in Emberwood's windmill, and some spectral silver thread - my seamstress, Edna, can help you there.

ReturnNoItemsDialogue2.src: I need dragon blood. It's the blood of the enemy and that always has mystical significance. I read about it in a book once.

ReturnToMirrorNotAllCandlesLit1.src: I'll need you to rekindle my memories, quite literally.

Candle_BeforeLit.src: No flame seems to touch this wick, as though it burns from something else.

ObjectiveTwoOne.src: Rekindle the memorial candles across Ashenfall.

ObjectiveTwo.src: Rekindle the memorial candles in Brynmoor, the Whispering Swamp, the Fractured Planes, the Stormtouched Highlands, Bloodblight Swap and Fellhollow.

IntroDialogue3.src: She even gave me the ritual to release myself to...err... taunt me, yes, taunt me. It's quite simple to resolve, really, it shouldn't take long.

ReturnNoItemsDialogue3.src: Spectral silver thread will help me stitch the mirror back together. My seamstress, Edna, can help you there. You can find her little cottage in the centre of Dragon's Run. She's...err... quite thin these days.

Goodbye.src: Thanks for your help. It'll be so nice to escape this mirror realm nightmare prison. Don't worry, I'm not going to go on some sinister evil rampage or anything. Honest.

QuestFinished.src: Thanks for your help. It'll be so nice to escape this mirror realm nightmare prison. Don't worry, I'm not going to go on some sinister evil rampage or anything. Honest.

SeamstressNoIngredients.src: The mistress needssss... bring me a bar of silver, a spool of fine thread, a bottle of sacred oil and six soul fragments – and I shall weave what she needsssss.

seamstresshasspace.src: The skeleton performs a series of gestures, too quick and strange for your eyes to follow. Then she hands you a spool of spectral silver thread. The skeleton returns to rest.

seamstressdontgive.src: The skeleton returns to rest, leaving you without your thread.

CandleWhisperingSwamps.src: The soul ignites the candle. A memory that is not yours seeps into your thoughts. A shared meal, tougher than it should be. A monster avoided through quick wit and guile. A silent conversation worth more than a thousand words.

CandleBrynmoor.src: The soul ignites the candle. A memory that is not yours seeps into your thoughts. Distrustful eyes fall upon you. Scorn and derision from every corner. The priests shake their head at you. Only one face smiles back beneath a mask of bone.

CandleFellhollow.src: The soul ignites the candle. A memory that is not yours seeps into your thoughts. You stare into the mirror, guilt finally quelling the rage that always burns in your chest. The nightmare all around you, your fault, but who will punish you, if not yourself?

CandleBloodblightSwamp.src: The soul ignites the candle. A memory that is not yours seeps into your thoughts. You've grown to like the antipoison's taste, a pick-me-up first thing in the morning. The cave is damp, but oddly comforting. The bodies of seven garou keep you warm as they burn. You wonder if you have a future in potions.

CandleFracturedPlains.src: The soul ignites the candle. A memory that is not yours seeps into your thoughts. Your fingers are warm, though his body grows colder with each second. There is no breath in his lungs and once bright eyes are cold and empty. A sorrow like no other grasps icy fingers around your heart and mercy dies to its frigid touch.

CandleStormtouchedHighlands.src: The soul ignites the candle. A memory that is not yours seeps into your thoughts. You pour your rage into the heavens, corrupting the veil a god placed there to protect. Dark magic turns clouds into weapons, blasting settlements with spears of lightning. You laugh, a cold and bitter sound, at the nightmare you've wrought.

IntroDialogue1.src: Wait! A person? An actual, real-life person and not some shambling nightmare picking rubbish out of its teeth? Hello! Hello! Oh, also, help?

PlayerDoesntHandOverIngredient_Response.src: Well, there's nothing I can do until you give me the ingredients. Don't worry, I'll be right here until you change your mind... right...here...

QuestComplete3.src: What? You don't need to stick around for that, I'm good now. I can stitch this mirror back together and then escape this reflective prison. You've done everything I need.

GotAllIngredients3.src: When one lives as long as I have, one's memories get a little overcrowded and sometimes you just need to put them somewhere for safekeeping. I've left a few of mine as "memorial candles" in each region I've visited.

ReturnToMirrorNotAllCandlesLit2.src: When one lives as long as I have, one's memories get a little overcrowded and sometimes you just need to put them somewhere for safekeeping. I've left a few of mine as "memorial candles" in each region I've visited.

GotAllIngredients2.src: Wonderful, I can start getting the ritual ready on my end. I just need something to tether myself back to your side of reality. I'll need you to rekindle my memories, quite literally.

NoSpaceForBook.src: You have no room in your inventory for this book. You'll need to make some space and come back for it later.

Seamstressnospace.src: You have no room to take thisss thread. Return to me when space is made among your belongings.

Skull.Description.src: A ghostly chinchompa skull. Vannaka is looking for these.

Vannaka.WildHuntCompleted.NotSpokenTo.In.src: Chinchompas. Ghostly little critters with explosive personalities. They threaten our efforts here, as the land does not understand we work in its interest.

Vannaka.QuestStarted.SpokenTo.NoProgress.src: Find those chinchompa spirits and put an end to them before they can put an end to you. If they explode, their essence will just reform somewhere else, so strike them before they can.

Objective.GatherSkulls.src: Gather 10 spectral chinchompa skulls and bring them to Vannaka in Fellhollow.

Quest.Description.src: Gather spectral chinchompa skulls so that Vannaka can help the land heal.

Vannaka.GotHeads.1.src: Good, that looks like enough of their skulls to send a message. I'm not good with magic, but there are old rituals, primal and primordial, that the land will listen to.

Vannaka.GenericGreeting.src: Hello there, young pup, what can I help you with?

Vannaka.GotHeads.InventoryFree.1.src: Here, something for your hard work. It's not much, young pup, but it'll be a reminder of the good work you've done for this place.

Vannaka.QuestStarted.NotSpokenToVannaka..src: Hrmm, what do you have there young pup? The spectral skulls of vengeful little spirits? I know what this means.
Hrmm, what do you have there young pup? The spectral skulls of vengeful little spirits? I know what this means.

Vannaka.QuestComplete.HasMoreSkulls.1.src: I see you've been hunting more of those spiritual pests. Nasty creatures those, best to get rid of them. Here, I'll take those skulls off your hands and give you something for your efforts.

Vannaka.PostQuest.GotSkulls.src: I see you've gathered a few more of those skulls, gather a few more and come back to me I'll reward you for every ten you find.

Vannaka.GotHeads.NoInventoryFree.1.src: I've got something for you, a thank you of sorts, but you're a little overburdened. Clear out some of that backpack and then come back and see me.

Vannaka.WildHuntCompleted.NotSpokenTo.In.src: If you bring me ten of their skulls, I can do what I can to help lay their spirits to rest. Perhaps we can curb some of this land's fury.

Vannaka.QuestStarted.SpokenTo.NoProgress.src: If you bring me their skulls, I can do what I can to help lay their spirits to rest. Perhaps we can curb some of this land's fury.

Vannaka.QuestComplete.HasMoreSkulls.Fini.src: If you find more of them, bring them to me. I'll take ten at a time, clear the problem up faster that way.

Vannaka.GotHeads.2.src: In time, thanks to this, and with Imaru's destruction, we may see the land return to the lush land it once was. In a few decades perhaps.

Vannaka.WildHuntCompleted.NotSpokenTo.In.src: It is the vet's hand that the dog bites most, after all. I need you to find these critters and hunt down as many as you can, before they explode and rip the land apart in the process.

Vannaka.PostQuest.1.src: It'll take some time for the land to heal, but when it does it'll remember the good work you've done for it. The land always remembers.

Vannaka.QuestComplete.HasSkulls.NoSpace..src: Or I would, if you weren't so overburdened. Clear some space, young pup, then come find me.

Vannaka.WildHuntCompleted.NotSpokenTo.In.src: The land is angry. Enraged at the corruption forced upon it and in turn it fights back. Dangerous spirits of destruction roam this land in the fluffiest of forms.

Quest.Name.src: Things That Go Boom In The Night

Vannaka.LinkFromWitherBeast.1.src: You've earned a rest, but if you're looking for work come back and see me. I have another task I could use your help with.

Vannaka.QuestStarted.NotSpokenToVannaka..src: You've got enough there for me to sort this mess out. An old ritual, primal and primordial nonsense -- not my favourite thing to work with, but needs must.

Vannaka.WildHuntCompleted.NotSpokenTo.In.src: Young pup, it seems like the spirits here are in dire trouble and I'll need a little more of your help to put things right.

Book1_Dialogue_4.src: *Great scratch marks of pencil obscure the rest of the page.*

Book5_Dialogue_3.src: *The letter is torn in half before any more can be said.*

Book2_Desc.src: A badly burned book wrapped in leather hide... at least you hope it's leather.

Book4_Desc.src: A religious tome discussing the god of rebellion.

Scroll1_Desc.src: A sealed scroll containing dark secrets.

Scroll2_Desc.src: A sealed scroll full of forbidden magic.

Scroll3_Desc.src: A sealed scroll full of the worst things imaginable.

Book3_Desc.src: A sinister book of truly nasty curses.

Book1_Desc.src: A study on elemental forces and their interactions with runic energies.

AbraxusIntroDialogue_1.src: Ah, apprentice... I assume you're an apprentice – with robes that shabby what else could you be? Still, needs must. Apprentice, I require your assistance.

Dowdun_1.src: Ah, hello apprentice. I'm sorry, I have no arrogant quips for you today... fate has been a most cruel mistress.

Book1_Dialogue_1.src: Among all the technical jargon, a note falls out.

ReturnAllScrolls_2.src: But I am not fool enough to believe you would find such a thing sufficient for your efforts. So, here, take this instead. May it serve you well.

Dowdun_3.src: But, now... now he barely remembers his name...

Book4_Dialogue_2.src: Dear Abraxus, I hope this letter finds you well. Dowdun Reach is proving both fascinating and infuriating in equal measure.

Book5_Dialogue_2.src: Dear Valerius, I am too cowardly to send this letter. Too afraid that you might burn it, or laugh at it, or worse still, ignore it. But if I do not say it now, I never will.

ObjectiveFindScrolls.src: Defeat Abraxus' enemies to retrieve the scrolls.

ObjectiveFindScrollsAndReturn.src: Defeat Abraxus' enemies to retrieve the scrolls. Then return them to Abraxus.

ReturnWithAllBooks_1.src: Excellent, excellent, you've found my books. I trust you were not fool enough to peak.

ObjectiveFindBooksAndReturn.src: Find five of Abraxus’ missing books in eastern Fellhollow and return them to him.

QuestDesc.src: Find the stolen knowledge and return it to its owner. I'm sure nothing bad will happen because of it.

Objective.FoundBookOrScrollBeforeAbraxus.src: Find the owner of the sinister text.

AbraxusIntroDialogue_4.src: Find them, all five of them, bring them to me and -- this is crucial -- do not read them. Your mind is too young, too limited to contain the dread secrets within! Well... hop to it!

AbraxusReturnWearingRobes_SomeBooks.src: Good, you've found some of my books. I need you to find the rest.

ReturnWithAllBooks_2.src: However, your assistance is still required, apprentice. Three of my secret scrolls have been stolen and you must reclaim them for me.

AbraxusNotWearingRobes_ReturnNoBooks2.src: I need you to find my books. Find them, all five of them, bring them to me and -- this is crucial -- do not read them. Your feeble mind cannot handle their secrets.

AbraxusWearingRobes_ReturnNoBooks.src: I need you to find my books. Find them, all five of them, bring them to me and -- this is crucial -- do not read them. Your feeble mind cannot handle their secrets.

AbraxusNotWearingRobes_ReturnNoBooks1.src: In disguise, are we? Blending in with the riff-raff and the yobs? Not sure I agree with such a plan, but you do you.

Book1_Dialogue_3.src:
It's your sparkling wit, your wicked smile.
With your every word, you do beguile.

Dowdun_5.src: Maybe, one day, he'll even remember me.

Book2_Dialogue_2.src: My dearest Abraxus, this keep is full of madmen and morons. People to whom power means strength and might, rather than unravelling the secrets of the universe.

ReturnAllScrolls_3.src: Now, if you'll excuse me, I need to mail a pebble to my... to an old friend of mine. See if that will let me haunt them for a while. I am so bored of this view.

IntroAlreadyHasBooks_1.src: Oh, but you already have my books. Are you in league with the thief, perhaps? Or are you simply more efficient than expected. No matter, your work is appreciated.

Book1_Dialogue_2.src:
On summer days, with bluer skies,
I am oft reminded of your eyes. 
On winter nights, by the fire we roast,
And I think about what I love the most.

ObjectiveFindBooks.src: Search the eastern areas of Fellhollow and find the books for Abraxus.

Book4_Dialogue_4.src: Still, I do wish you would join me. I think you might find there are wonderful secrets to uncover when one is not shackled by pointless morality.

Dowdun_4.src: Still, what good is eternity if you cannot look after the ones you lo... those that matter most? So, I'll keep an eye on him for now.

Book2_Dialogue_1.src: The book is written in the language of Infernus and impossible to read. However, a perfumed note is stuffed between the pages...

ReturnSomeScrolls_2.src: The first was stolen by a wretched green dragon known as Blightscale. Arrogant creature, you must make a lesson of her hubris.

ReturnWithAllBooks_3.src: The first was stolen by a wretched green dragon known as Blightscale. Arrogant creature, you must make a lesson of her hubris.

ReturnSomeScrolls_4.src: The last was taken by a rival of mine, Razlem – The Deranged. A far less skilled necromancer than myself, but dangerous nonetheless.

ReturnWithAllBooks_5.src: The last was taken by a rival of mine, Razlem – The Deranged. A far less skilled necromancer than myself, but dangerous nonetheless.

ReturnSomeScrolls_3.src: The second scroll was taken by a zogre known as Ulgo. Foul creature, stinks beyond comprehension, but I'm sure you can handle it.

ReturnWithAllBooks_4.src: The second scroll was taken by a zogre known as Ulgo. Foul creature, stinks beyond comprehension, but I'm sure you can handle it.

Book3_Dialogue_1.src: This book appears to be a grimoire of terrible curses. When you open it a crumpled note falls out.

Book4_Dialogue_1.src: This book appears to be a religious dissertation on the merits of the Zamorak faith. When you open it a letter falls out.

Book5_Desc.src: This book squirms in your backpack, as though trying to escape.

Book5_Dialogue_1.src: This tome writhes beneath your fingertips, as if infused with some dread spirit. It practically spits a letter out at you.

ReturnSomeScrolls_1.src: Three of my secret scrolls have been stolen and you must reclaim them for me.

Dowdun_2.src: Valerius here, he used to be a shining thunderstorm of genius. A wizard who could have made the world tremble if he could turn himself away from his books, just for a time.

Book2_Dialogue_3.src: We are looking to create a demonic portal, that we might summon beings from another world. Imagine! We could learn so much!

AbraxusNotWearingRobes_Intro.src: What do you want? I have little time for the likes of you. Only a member of my own order can assist me and you certainly don't look the part.

Book4_Dialogue_3.src: Whilst we are not limited by the prattling sensibilities of the village wizards, they replace it with a sort of blind aggression and anger against everyone.

AbraxusIntroDialogue_2.src: Yes, yes, I know, I know. You stand in the presence of Abraxus The Eternal, master of necromancy. Keeper of secrets, both occult and arcane.

Book2_Dialogue_4.src: Yet they will just try and raise an army. Urgh! How I wish you were here with me. We could show them what a real wizard can do.

AbraxusIntroDialogue_3.src: You are very blessed, I am sure. Now, I need you to assist me. My library has been ransacked by the locals and my most precious tomes spread across the eastern parts of this region.

BookInteraction.src: You find one of Abraxus' books.

Scroll2_Text.src: You find one of Abraxus' scrolls. Each time you look at the scroll, you could swear the text is different to the last time you looked.

Scroll3_Text.src: You find one of Abraxus' scrolls. It's too awful, you cannot bring yourself to read it.

Scroll1_Text.src: You find one of Abraxus' scrolls. The writing crawls along the page, making it impossible to read without strange arcane knowledge.

ReturnAllScrolls_1.src: You have done well my apprentice and earned something no one else has earned in centuries – my respect.

Book3_Dialogue_3.src: You make me a very undignified wizard, Abraxus. Very undignified indeed.

Book3_Dialogue_2.src: You make me so angry, Abraxus. A fire I cannot put out. I want to shout at you. I want to kick you down the stairs. I want to wrap my arms around you and scream into your chest.

Vannaka.PostQuest.LessThanThreeHearts.2.src: Ah, but I see you've been liberating more nature spirits. Good work. It may feel strange, but you're doing them a favour, trust me. Tell you what, bring me three of them and I'll give you some of those shiny stones Death seems so interested in.

Vannaka.NoInventorySpace.src: Ah, or I would give them to you if you had any room. Make some space and then come back and talk to me.

Vannaka.NotStarted.GatheredAllThreeHeart.src: Ah... but your a skilled hunter, young pup, I see you've already gathered them.

Objective.BringHeartNotStarted.src: Bring the Primordial Heart to someone with an interest in the wild hunt.

Vannaka.Intro.4.src: Don't worry, they're meant to be hunted. That's the spirit way, a spirit of nature should be hunted by a predator, not slowly drained away by a monster, and you're the apex predator here.

Vannaka.Intro.2.src: Even this willow grove, once home to a proud and magnificent nature spirit, is now corrupted by wither and rot. That poor spirit has withered away to nothing.

Quest.Description.src: Help Vannaka safeguard Fellhollow's nature spirits, by hunting them down, in willow groves, and collecting their hearts.

Vannaka.PostQuest.NoHearts.1.src: How are you and your new friend getting on? Running wild and free, I hope. See, you did them a favour by hunting them here. Now they're safe from this land's blighted curse.

Objective.HuntBeast.src: Hunt down Nature Spirits near Fellhollow's willow groves and bring three of their hearts to Vannaka.

Vannaka.NotStarted.GatheredAtLeastOneHea.src: I see you're part way there already. Just need to get the rest and we can help this spirit escape Imaru's foul curse.

Vannaka.PostQuest.GotHearts.3.src: I'll take them off your hands and you can take these in their place. Shiny little stones that old Harold loves so much.

Vannaka.Intro.3.src: If this land is ever going to heal, we need to save the rest of those spirits and the only way to save them, is to hunt them and kill them.

Vannaka.PostQuest.Info.1.src: If you find another three hearts on your travels, bring them to me and I'll exchange them for some of those shiny soul fragments that Harold seems so fond of.

Vannaka.QuestStarted.GotHearts.2.src: It's a way to liberate the spirit from this place. Allow it to run free and wild, bound to a new anchor, one able to give them freedom.

Vannaka.QuestStarted.NotProgressed.1.src: Look for willow groves, like this one, those are places where nature spirits thrive. There's a few to the west of here. Bring me three of their hearts and we can find a way to keep them safe from this withering hunger.

Vannaka.QuestStarted.NotGotHearts.2.src: Look for willow groves, those are places where nature spirits thrive. There's a few to the west of here. Bring me the spirits' hearts and we can find a way to keep them safe from this withering hunger.

Vannaka.QuestStarted.NotGotHearts.1.src: Majestic creatures, aren't they? I'm sure it feels strange to have to hunt them, but trust me we're doing them a favour. You're part way there, but I'll need more hearts.

Vannaka.Intro.1.src: Not a pleasant landscape this, ey, young pup? Life is fading, drained away by a dragon's hunger. Rotten creatures, dragons.

Vannaka.QuestStarted.GotHearts.3.src: That anchor is you. Now, one moment and... here... that should do it. With a little magic, that spirit will carry you across Ashenfall. Give it a good run, won't you?

Vannaka.PostQuest.GotHearts.1.src: You and your spirit friend seem happy together, young pup. Always good to see that sort of bond between man and beast.

Vannaka.PostQuest.LessThanThreeHearts.1.src: You and your spirit friend seem happy together, young pup. Always good to see that sort of bond between man and beast.

Vannaka.QuestStarted.GotHearts.1.src: You did it, well done. Now, the tricky part. I asked you to get these hearts because of a garou ritual I learned. An old one, from their time before Kuldra.

Vannaka.Intro.5.src: You'll be doing this place a favour by hunting them, trust me. Look for willow groves, like this one, those are places where nature spirits thrive. Bring me three of their hearts and we can find a way to keep them safe from this withering hunger.

Vannaka.PostQuest.GotHearts.2.src: You've gathered another three hearts for me from the nature spirits? Good, very good. You're a skilled hunter, young pup, you should be proud.

Crystal.Description.src: A crystal that Doric obtained from a cave near the river Salve, back in Misthalin. Used in creating the Salve amulet.

Objective.FindRecipe.src: Access the vault and find the hidden secret within.

Objective.ReturnToDoric.src: Bring the dwarven writing to Doric.

Objective.LookForDoric.src: Find someone in Fellhollow that can translate dwarvish text.

Quest.Description.src: Find the statues to gain entrance to the vault and uncover the secrets that lie within.

Doric.FoundStatue.HasInventorySpace.1.src: Hope it helps in your travels.

Doric.PostQuest.1.src: Hope that amulet helps you out. There are a lot of them shamblin'orribles out there and anything to keep 'em off you feels like a good thing.

Doric.Intro.1.src: I don't like this place, it's creepy and weird. Had to whack several zombies with my hammer and now it's got this weird purple ooze on it that won't wash off.

Doric.FoundStatue.2.src: I guess we'll never know. Here, let me translate this for you, hopefully it'll help you on your travels.

Doric.QuestStarted.NoProgress.2.src: If you can find your way inside, let me know if you discover anything interesting.

Doric.FoundStatue.4.src: Oh! Ha, you're gonna laugh at this, but I actually have one of them river Salve gemstones. I found one a few years back and I just keep it with me as a good luck charm. Here, you should take it, make yourself one of those salve amulets.

Doric.FoundStatue.DoesNotHaveInventorySp.src: Oh, you don't appear to have the space for it. Come back and see me when you do.

Doric.Intro.2.src: Still, I'm betting there's something interesting waiting around here. There are vaults in this place and they must be loaded with dragonkin secrets.

Doric.QuestStarted.NoProgress.1.src: Taken a look in that locked vault yet? There must be a trick to it. Those dragonkin were a smart lot, secretive... and arrogant as heck.

Doric.FoundStatue.3.src: Well now, that is unexpected. This is the Salve amulet... why is this here? It requires a gemstone only found by the river Salve back in Misthalin. I mean, it's handy against the undead, so it'll be real useful here.

Doric.FoundStatue.1.src: Well, will you look at that, another dwarven tablet. Why were the dragonkin out here stealing dwarven secrets?

Doric.Intro.3.src: Who knows what you might find? I discovered one vault, and I was all geared up to visit, but it's locked down tight. Hey, I know, if you get a chance why don't you take a look? Let me know what you find inside.

Statue.Discover.1.src: You find strange dwarven writings that you cannot read. Perhaps Doric can translate for you.

Statue.Discover.NotStarted.1.src: You find strange dwarven writings that you cannot read. Perhaps someone can translate for you.

Door.SealBroken.src: You hear the sound of a dragonkin lock releasing.

Journal3.src:
A bunch of backstabbers. All of them cowards and fools. The wounds we gave one another guarantee no one will ever find our treasures.

A shared plunder, between us all, lays buried deep.

Journal2.src:
I have chosen here to rest, to close my eyes and never see the dawn. I am tired, so tired, and will welcome the longest, deepest sleep.

I hope my companions found peace in their final moments. Between us all, we will keep the secret.

Journal4.src:
I wonder if we shouldn't have left it buried. If we should have brought it back to the village for all to see. What wonders, what secrets, could we reveal? Answers to questions we never knew we had. 

Now, between us four, that secret lays buried. I wonder if that is our greatest mistake?

IntroJournal.src:
They say you cannot take it with you, yet people certainly try. Kings, pharaohs and emperors are all buried with enough gold to keep a kingdom running for years. So, if they cannot take it with them, maybe someone else can.

That someone, is me. There is treasure in Fellhollow, even though the villagers claim otherwise. The richest of them bury their gold with flimsy clues so that their descendants may uncover their riches and live as kings.

I'm sure I'm related to one of them, somewhere down the line, so I figure I'm as entitled to that wealth as anyone else.

I don't know where the treasure is buried, but others have gone looking. Four others have sought these riches and between them I'm sure those riches lie.

Journal1.src:
We have plundered the very depths of Fellhollow and perhaps we have dug too deep? What lays buried should stay buried.

Each of us turned from the other, back to back and walked away. Not one of us alone knows the location, only together will the secret be revealed. 

And we are no longer talking.

WS_WiseOldMan_Intro5.src: A bit of damage to your soul. Don't worry, it's not permanent, but perhaps avoid overindulging in wardstones, eh?

WoM_SkippedTutorial_IKnowYou_1.src: A lifetime of heroism and no recognition. But you rob one bank and suddenly everyone knows your name!

Zanik_SkippedTutorial_Intro1.src: A new adventure is always exciting, don't you think? We lost some good people... friends... but we need to push forward, in their memory.

Zanik_RM_Intro4.src: About fifty ash logs should do it, so make sure you've got a well maintained axe. Shouldn't take too long, come back to me when you have them.

Doric_RTftJ_GotWater1.src: Ah good, you've got some water. Bit dirty, I know, but better than nothing. Be careful though, the water's tainted and it'll make life difficult if you drink too much.

WS_WiseOldMan_Intro1.src: Ah, I see you've discovered Ashenfall's little "blacksmith benefit", as I like to call it. Lifeward!

Doric_RTftJ_Intro_AlreadyGotWater1.src: Ah, but you've got a good head on yer shoulders. I see you've already got some water, so you won't die of thirst.

Doric_RTftJ_GotCleanWater1.src: Ah, good, you've got some nice clean water there. The water in lakes and rivers tends to be dirty, tainted by something nasty that will make life difficult if you drink too much.

WS_WiseOldMan_Wardstone_Choice_01.src: Ah, hello. What would you like to discuss?

WS_WiseOldMan_MadeStone1.src: Ah, you've made one. Lovely. See, that barely hurt at all. Just a little drop of blood, nothing to cry about. But now, when your lifeward is damaged, you can repair it.

Doric_RTftJ_Intro2.src: And look at ya! Not a knife to yer name, no, no, we can't be doing with that. Come on, let's get you prepared. You need to go and craft a stone club.

WoM_Generic.src: Aren't you helping the others out? What are you talking to me for? Check your map if you're not sure what you're meant to be doing.

Zanik_SkippedTutorial_CanYouTellMeAboutA.src: As well as goblins. Look at the creatures here. So vibrant and full of life. This whole place feels... magical.

WS_Playerchoice_Askabout_DragonSlayer.src: Ask about the Dragon Slayer quest.

Zanik_RM_HasLogs3.src: Axtral projection will let you slice down trees with a wave of your fingers. Much less time consuming than the lumberjack gig.

Doric_RTftJ_MadeClub1.src: Aye, that's a fine club you got there, but even the best weapons break over time. When that happens use a crafting bench to repair your gear.

Vannaka_SkippedTutorial_CanYouTellMeAbou.src: Be ready to fight, that's my first piece of advice. Craft armour, weapons and anything else you need for battle.

Doric_RTftJ_MadeClub2.src: Before you go, here, something to help you on your way.

Vannaka_RC_Intro3.src: Behind me, up that little hill, is a windmill infested with rats. I want you to kill some of them and cook their meat.

Zanik_RM_LinkToWoM2.src: Better not keep him waiting too long, he gets real cranky.

Doric_RTftJ_NotMadeClub2.src: Both require stone and ash logs, which you'll find scattered all over the ground around here.

WS_WiseOldMan_Objective3.src: Bring your Small Wardstone to the Wise Old Man.

WoM_FS_Intro3.src: But before all that, how about we take you through some survival basics?

Doric_RTftJ_Intro_WaterNeeded1.src: But look at you, all skin and bones. Must be proper parched after a journey like that.

WoM_FS_SkippedTutorial2.src: But not here. Come find me in Bramblemead Village, and we'll get you started.

Doric_SkippedTutorial_CanYouTellMeAboutA.src: But you see that great tower, off in the distance? That's dragonkin that is. Means there's probably stuff worth finding about this place.

Zanik_RM_HasLogs4.src: But, magic comes at a cost -- runes. You'll need both air and astral runes to cast Axtral projection, so here's how to get them.

Doric_RTftJ_Intro1.src: By Saradomin's big bushy beard! Just our luck, a great ruddy dragon. Think it were him that got the others - may they rest in peace.

Playerchoice_TellMeAboutAshenfall.src: Can you tell me about Ashenfall?

WS_WiseOldMan_Objective2.src: Craft a Small Wardstone at a Crafting Table and bring it to the Wise Old Man.

WS_WiseOldMan_Intro2.src: Crafting certain equipment intrinsically involves the weaving of small threads of enchantment, granting you greater protection.

Vannaka_SkippedTutorial_WhoAreYou_2.src: Cull the monster population to make the world a better place.

Zanik_RM_SpokenTo_NoLogs.src: Cut down trees and gather 50 ash logs, then bring them to me.

Doric_RTftJ_Intro_WaterNeeded2.src: Dehydration and starvation are deadlier than dragons, so you're going to need to keep an eye on your basic needs, like hunger and thirst.

Vannaka_RC_Intro4.src: Don't pull that face, you can't be a picky eater in a place like this. Food will make you healthier and heartier, and much more likely to survive.

RTftJ_Description.src: Doric wants to teach you some survival basics.

Zanik_RM_Intro1.src: Dragons, it had to be dragons. Oh, hi, sorry, nice to meet you, I'm Zanik. I'm the local survival and goblin expert around here.

WoM_FS_SkippedTutorial1.src: Fair enough, I do like someone that can show initiative.

Zanik_RM_HasLogs2.src: Fortunately, we've got magic! As you improve in a skill you'll discover spells that you can use, such as my favourite - Axtral Projection.

Doric_Generic.src: Gathering resources and crafting items, that's the basics of survival in this place. Seek out new resources to discover new recipes.

Vannaka_RC_NotDoneRTftJ.src: Getting ahead of yourself, aren't we, young pup? Check your map to see where you're meant to be headed.

WS_WiseOldMan_NotMadeStone.src: Go and craft a wardstone and bring it here so I can check your working. You just need to gather some rune essence and stone, and craft them at a crafting table. Nice and simple. One wardstone will do.

WS_WiseOldMan_Intro6.src: Go and craft me one small wardstone and bring it here so I can check your working. You just need to gather some rune essence and stone, and craft it at a crafting table. Nice and simple. One small wardstone will do.

Zanik_RM_HasRunes1.src: Great work! Runes are the lifeblood of magic, you'll need them to cast spells and use magic staves. A well placed spell can make all the difference.

Zanik_RM_HasLogs1.src: Great, you've got them. Now, between you and me, that was a bit repetitive right? I'd be exhausted having to do that all the time.

WS_WiseOldMan_Intro3.src: Handy stuff, especially with dragons about. Now, you'll find that your lifewards can get depleted by the brutality of the other creatures on Ashenfall.

WoM_FS_AcceptedTutorial3.src: He's the only dwarf on the continent, that we know of anyway, can't miss him.

Zanik_RM_Intro3.src: Here, I'll show you. First, let's look at things without magic to help you. I need you to cut down a couple of trees and bring me some ash logs. Simple, right?

WS_WiseOldMan_NoInventorySpace.src: Hrmm, I have something for you, but it appears you've overloaded yourself like a magpie gone mad. Clear some space, then come and see me.

Vannaka_NoRoomInInventory.src: Hrmm, seems you're carrying the weight of the world right now. Come see me again when you've got some space free in your backpack.

WS_WiseOldMan_NoLongerNeeded.src: Hrmm... well, this is awkward, as all of this...well it's gone now. Here, let me just complete this for you, get it all out of the way. No reward, that wouldn't be fair, let's just pretend it never happened shall we?

Player_Choice_FS_SkipTutorial.src: I can work it out [Skip Tutorial]

Playerchoice_IKnowYou.src: I recognise you from the wanted posters!

Zanik_NotDoneRTftJ.src: I think someone is looking for you. Mentioned a task they needed you to complete. Check your map for where to find them.

Vannaka_SkippedTutorial_WhoAreYou_3.src: I was finding things a little stale on the mainland. When I saw the posters for the expedition, I felt a pull... a call to adventure that I could not resist.

Zanik_SkippedTutorial_CanYouTellMeAboutA.src: I wonder why they're not in the history books.

Zanik_SkippedTutorial_WhoAreYou_1.src: I'm Zanik. I'm a cave goblin. Sort of like the goblins over there in Bramblemead village... only we chose peace over violence.

Zanik_SkippedTutorial_WhoAreYou_3.src: I'm regretting it a bit, what with big scary dragons and all, but I'm excited too. Looking forward to learning everything about this place.

Doric_RTftJ_Intro_WaterNeeded3.src: I've marked two ponds on your map: to the northwest and south of us. Grab some water from there and bring it back here. Then I'll teach you what you'll need to survive.

Doric_RTftJ_Intro_WaterNeeded4.src: If you see a redberry bush along the way, grab yourself a handful. Not much of a meal, but a little food is better than no food at all.

Vannaka_RC_HasKebabs2.src: It may not exactly be gourmet cooking, but a meal like this could make the difference between life and death. You'll not be taking on any dragons if you're starving to death.

Doric_RTftJ_Intro3.src: It won't kill a dragon, but it's better than nothing and it'll help you live a bit longer, giving you time to make something better.

Doric_SkippedTutorial_CanYouTellMeAboutA.src: It's a wild place this. Beasties everywhere, and no civilisation in sight. Just the remnants, ghosts of the past.

WS_WiseOldMan_MadeStone3.src: Just don't use too many at once and you'll be fine. Right, go on, get out here and go slay that dragon!

WS_WiseOldMan_MadeStone2.src: Just use a wardstone and BAM! Instant lifeward recharge. Sure, it'll tear a bit from your soul, but so will listening to Doric talk about hammers for three hours.

Vannaka_SkippedTutorial_Intro_1.src: Keep your wits about you, young pup. Ashenfall is home to many a dangerous beast, and I've not yet tested my blade against each of them.

Doric_SkippedTutorial_WhoAreYou_2.src: Left my son behind to watch the shop. Good lad, gonna do good things. Hope he's not too worried about his dad.

Vannaka_Generic.src: Life on Ashenfall is rarely peaceful. Make sure you're well fed and always have a weapon to hand. Keep an eye on enemy weaknesses to dispatch them quickly.

Vannaka_RC_Intro2.src: Look, you may have a weapon, but every great warrior knows wars are won by the stomach, not the blade.

Doric_SkippedTutorial_WhoAreYou_1.src: Me? Name's Doric. I'm just a stupid old blacksmith who got swept up by tales of adventure. Trying to win back me glory days.

RM_Zanik_Objective2.src: Mine Rune Essence, craft some Air and Astral Runes by building a Rune Altar or from Siphoning Anima Vents.

Zanik_SkippedTutorial_WhoAreYou_2.src: Most of my people stay underground, hiding from the surface. But I couldn't wait to explore this vast and wonderful world.

Vannaka_SkippedTutorial_WhoAreYou_1.src: My name's Vannaka. Back on the mainland I was a Slayer Master. It was my job to send adventurers after dangerous beasts.

Zanik_RM_HasLogs_NoRunes.src: Not made the runes yet? You'll need to mine essence from the floating geysers and then craft air and astral runes either by building a rune altar or by siphoning from nearby Anima Vents.

Doric_RTftJ_NextStep.src: Now you've got something to fight with, go chat to Vannaka over to the north east, he can teach you how to keep fighting fit.

Doric_RTftJ_MadeDagger2.src: Now, even the best weapons break over time. When that happens use a crafting bench to repair your gear.

Doric_SkippedWom.src: Oh dear, you just walked right past the Wise Old Man. He won't like that. Best go back and say hi, eh?

Doric_NoRoomInInventory.src: Oh dear, you seem a little overburdened at the moment. Come and see me when you've got some space free in your backpack.

Zanik_NoRoomInInventory.src: Oh wow, bit of a packrat are we? You're carrying too much right now, come back and chat with me when you've cleared some space from your backpack.

Doric_RTftJ_Intro5.src: Oh, I'm Doric by the way. Resident blacksmith and craftsperson on this expedition. Nice to meet you. Now, stop standing around and go make that club!

WoM_FS_DragonSlayer_Started.src: Oh, don't mind me here. I'm just enjoying the architecture. I'll meet you at Bramblemead Village if you want to chat.

WoM_SkippedTutorial_WhoAreYou_1.src: Oh, the cruelty of time, erasing even our deeds. I was once a famous and adored hero. Now everyone just calls me "that wise old man". Rude really.

Doric_RTftJ_MadeDagger1.src: Oh, you made a dagger, not a club? Aye, it's a nice piece of work, not what I asked for, but that's fine.

Vannaka_SkippedTutorial_CanYouTellMeAbou.src: Past Bramblemead is Ghornfell, a place of danger and excitement. Something calls to me out there and I intend to seek it out.

WoM_SkippedTutorial_CanYouTellMeAboutAsh.src: Probably goes some way to explaining the enormous dragon that wants to kill us... along with all the other things that want to kill us.

Vannaka_RC_Intro5.src: Properly cook a rat roast and bring them back to me. You'll probably burn a few along the way, don't let that disuade you. No one said survival would be pretty.

Vannaka_RC_HasKebabs4.src: Rats, for example, don't take kindly to getting stabbed. Here, take this little butterknife to make it easier to fight them in future. You can have this as well, it'll help you with what's next.

Vannaka_RC_HasKebabs5.src: Right, let's teach you a bit about magic. Zanik's the one to talk to for that, you can find her down the road just before the river.

Zanik_RM_LinkToWoM1.src: Right, now that you've learned the basics, it's time to get started. The Wise Old Man is waiting for you just outside Bramblemead Village. Follow your compass to find him.

Zanik_RM_HasLogs5.src: See those geysers around, with the floating rocks? Take this pickaxe and mine some essence from them. From here you can use rune essence to craft some air or astral runes either by building your own rune altar or by siphoning from air or astral Anima vents found nearby.

RM_Zanik_Objective1.src: Speak to Zanik near the river, down the road from the temple.

WS_WiseOldMan_Objective1.src: Speak to the Wise Old Man to learn about lifewards.

Doric_RTftJ_Intro_AlreadyGotWater2.src: Still, it's going to be tough surviving this place with a dragon about.

Doric_SkippedTutorial_WhoAreYou_3.src: Still, no point lollygagging around. I'll catch my breath and then explore these new lands. Who knows? Might find something.

Doric_SkippedTutorial_Intro_1.src: Strange place this. Ashenfall, I mean. Could make a real home here if things stopped trying to kill us.

WS_QuestDesc.src: The Wise Old Man wants to teach you about lifewards and how to recharge them.

Zanik_RM_Intro2.src: The interesting thing about Ashenfall is that it's laced with magic. Anima everywhere, pouring out of the ground. Which we can use to our advantage.

WoM_SkippedTutorial_CanYouTellMeAboutAsh.src: The whole continent feels like it's infused with anima. Literally pouring out of the ground in some places. That's just not normal.

Vannaka_SkippedTutorial_CanYouTellMeAbou.src: There are goblins everywhere in Bramblemead, and deadlier things beyond.

Zanik_SkippedTutorial_CanYouTellMeAboutA.src: There are goblins here. That's unexpected. I thought I knew all the tribes, but there's a whole load of them here.

Zanik_Generic.src: There are secrets hidden all over Ashenfall, I'm sure of it. Look around, explore, and see what you can find.

WS_WiseOldMan_Intro4.src: To recharge them, you'll need to craft yourself wardstones. These impressive little doohickies will recharge the lifeward enchantments on your armour... at a small cost.

RC_Description.src: Vannaka wants to teach you the basics of hunting, fighting and cooking.

Zanik_NotDoneRC.src: Vannaka was looking for you, mentioned something about fine dining?

WoM_SkippedTutorial_CanYouTellMeAboutAsh.src: We've not been here that long, but I can tell you that Ashenfall is special. You must feel it? Magic everywhere?

WoM_FS_Intro1.src: Welcome to Ashenfall, sorry about the mess. Had a bit of a dragon problem, that's why we've called for you.

Vannaka_RC_Intro_Dagger.src: Well met, young pup. Looking to get yourself ready to face off against a dragon? You'll need more than that butter knife to kill one, but you've got to start somewhere.

Vannaka_RC_Intro1.src: Well met, young pup. Looking to get yourself ready to face off against a dragon? You'll need more than that potato masher to kill one, but you've got to start somewhere.

Vannaka_RC_NoProgress1.src: Well met, young pup. Seems like you haven't managed to cook that rat roast for me yet. You can get them by killing giant rats and cooking their meat. You can find some up by the windmill.

Vannaka_RC_HasKebabs1.src: Well met, young pup. Seems your hunt was successful, I see you've gathered the food I asked for.

Vannaka_RC_HasKebabs3.src: You will find rats are annoyingly resilient to clubs. Some enemies can resist certain damage types and be vulnerable to others.

WoM_FS_AcceptedTutorial2.src: You'll find him outside the temple. Check your map if you get lost, but he should be easy to spot.

Doric_RTftJ_Intro4.src: You'll need to gather stone and ash logs, which you can find laying around, then you'll want to build a crafting table to craft the club.

Zanik_RM_HasRunes2.src: You'll unlock new spells as you improve your skills. Here, this book should help you toward that. Have a play around with them, you'll find they can be incredibly useful.

Doric_RTftJ_NotMadeClub1.src: You'll want to build yourself a crafting table. Then once you've done that craft yourself a stone club.

WoM_FS_AcceptedTutorial1.src: You'll want to get to grips with gathering and crafting first, Doric can help you with that.

WoM_FS_Intro2.src: You've come at a great time. Heroic opportunities await. This long-forgotten place is just screaming to be explored.

Doric_RTftJ_GotWater2.src: Zanik says boiling it sorts it out. So, might want to give that a look later, when you've got a chance. Anyway, time we got you all set up to survive this harsh land.

LO_Description.src: Zanik wants to teach you the basics of woodcutting.

RM_Description.src: Zanik wants you to learn the basics of crafting runes.

FlavourText_FinishedFarmingTutorialPack.src: A cloth bag with some useful items for farmers.

WoM.QuestionHub.IntroReturn.src: Anything else I can help you with?

WoM.QuestionHub.Compost.1.src: Compost improves the yield on your crops when you harvest them. They simply love to spread their roots around in the stinky stuff.

FlavourText_FarmingTutorialPack.src: Contains different types of seeds from brynmoor.

WoM.QuestionHub.PlantingSeeds.1.src: First, you'll need to build a farming plot. Use a spade on it to clear it of weeds. Once it's completely clear, you're ready to plant.

WoM.QuestionHub.Compost.3.src: Give it a little time for the newly added stuff to rot down into compost and then take a Compost Bucket and fill it up.

WoM.QuestionHub.Watering.2.src: Grab yourself a watering can, fill it with water at a water source, and then liberally douse your patch until it's fully soaked through.

Objective.HarvestCrop.src: Grow and harvest your first crop from a farming plot.

WoM.TalkAboutFarming.Intro.4.src: Here, take these to get you started.

WoM.TalkAboutFarming.Intro.1.src: I see you've started to get a little green around the thumbs! Farming will make survival on Ashenfall a little less horrible.

WoM.QuestionHub.PlantingSeeds.2.src: Just grab the seeds in your hand, and then whack em into the soil. No need for grace, or ceremony, just whomp them in and they'll be fine.

Quest.Description.src: Learn the basics of the Farming skill from the Wise Old Man.

WoM.TalkAboutFarming.Finished.1.src: Look at you, practically master farmer already. Farming is a wonderful way to keep yourself well fed, and with access to useful materials.

WoM.QuestionHub.Watering.3.src: Make sure to water your plants every day, ideally first thing in the morning, to keep them nice and healthy.

WoM.TalkAboutFarming.NoInventorySpace.src: Oh? You've overburdened yourself with all the random things you can cram in your pockets. Come back and see me when you've made a bit of room.

WoM.QuestionHub.Watering.1.src: Plants are like people, they need water to survive. You'll want to keep your plants nice and hydrated, so that they don't succumb to disease.

Objective.FinishQuest.src: Return to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead.

Objective.SpeakToWOM1.src: Speak to the Wise Old Man, in Bramblemead, to learn about the Farming skill.

WoM.TalkAboutFarming.Finished.2.src: Speaking of useful, here, take this. My little gift to you. Just don't tell the others, they'll get all jealous again.

WoM.QuestionHub.Compost.4.src: Then just pour the contents of your bucket over the farming plot, making sure it's spread over it as fully as possible.

WoM.QuestionHub.Compost.2.src: To make compost, you'll first need to build a Compost Bin. Then you'll want to fill it with compostible ingredients, like weeds, unwanted logs or irritating exes.

WoM.QuestionHub.IntroFirstTime.src: What would you like to know?

WoM.TalkAboutFarming.Intro.3.src: Why don't you go and give it a proper go right now? Go harvest some crops and then come back and see me. I'll give you a little something for your efforts.

WoM.TalkAboutFarming.Intro.2.src: You'll be able to grow fruits, vegetables, and all manner of plants. Food, potion ingredients and perhaps some crafting resources too!

WoM.NotSpokenTo.Intro.3.src: Ah, but I haven't eaten a good fish for ages! Hrmm... how about you look around and see if you could find me a sardine in the waters around here? You'll need a Fishing Rod to catch one though! You may want to consider crafting some bait too!

WoM.SpokenTo.HasFish.1.src: Ah, wonderful: a delicious sardine. It brings back old memories. Now I just need to fry it up, just like old grampa used to. Thank you, adventurer. Here, for your troubles.

WoM.NotSpokenTo.Intro.1.src: Aha, a very useful tool you've managed to make for yourself, there. Why, I remember in my, admittedly distant, youth, spending countless hours trying to catch something from a local pond with one. The owners were not happy.

WoM.OptionalLink.src: Anything else I can help you with?

WoM.ExtraInfo.WhatDoWithFishies.1.src: Boil them, roast them, put them in a stew. You can make all sorts of delicious dishes from all sorts of fishes. Oh, and if you find some really nice ones, you can put them on display if you want to show off your angling skills.

PlayerChoice.Bait.src: Can you tell me about bait?

PlayerChoice.Nets.src: Can you tell me about fishing with nets?

PlayerChoice.Rods.src: Can you tell me about rod fishing?

WOM.ExtraInfo.Rods.2.src: Do it long enough and the fish will become exhausted for a short time. That’s your cue to reel it in! Just keep an eye on your stamina and don’t get sloppy, or you’ll snap the line and watch your prize swim away.

Objective.StartFishing.src: Fish a Sardine at a fishing spot near the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead Village.

WoM.ExtraInfo.Nets.1.src: It is the simplest thing in the world. Just equip your net in your hands, stand inside of the Net Fishing Spot and start trawling. The small fish are hidden away, among all types of junk, so don't be discouraged.

WoM.ExtraInfo.Bait.1.src: Oh, now those are interesting. You see, each fish has different tastes, and if you have bait that a fish likes equipped while fishing, you get a better chance of catching them.

Objective.ReturnToWoM.src: Return to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead Village.

WoM.ExtraInfo.Bait.2.src: Some fish like eating other, smaller, fish - the sort you can find with your net. Others prefer a moving target, and jingly things like feathers draw their attention.

Objective.SpeakToWiseOldMan.src: Speak to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead Village to learn about Fishing.

WoM.SpokenTo.NoFish.src: Still looking for fish? I have a few tips that might help.

WoM.ExtraInfo.Rods.src: That’s where it gets interesting. Fish don’t exactly want to be caught, so they will put up a fight! Once one bites, it’ll try to bolt and you'll need to wear it out. Move from side to side to counter the direction it’s swimming in and keep the pressure on.

Quest.Description.src: The Wise Old Man has some tips on how to grow as an amateur angler.

WoM.ExtraInfo.Nets.2.src: The more you practice, the easier it will become to catch something. Stronger fish require stronger nets, so remember to upgrade!

WoM.ExtraInfo.FishFood.src: They say fish-based food is the best way to restore your lost health! Definitely worth the effort to catch and cook them!

PlayerChoice.WhatDo.src: What can I do with the fish?

WoM.NotSpokenTo.Intro.2.src: Why, if you can find yourself a nice spot, it can be a relaxing way to wile away the dull daylight hours between adventures - challenging yourself to find that one pristine fish you see, mockingly swimming in the waters before you.

UI.FTUE.DodgeBlockAndParryControls.src:
1. {BlockButton} to block.
2. {EvadeButton} to dodge.
3. Blocking an enemy attack at the right moment will parry an enemy attack.
4. Enemies that have been parried take more damage.

UI.FTUE.BedsText.src: A bed will let you rest and gives you somewhere to recover if you're too badly hurt.

UI.FTUE.StealthArcheryText.src: A bow is great for taking our targets from the shadows. Try sneaking to make it harder for others to spot you.

UI.FTUE.ProcessingFuelText.src: A good fire is a great way to keep warm, but you'll need to keep it burning. A steady supply of kindling stops it from burning out.

UI.FTUE.BuildingBeamsText.src: Adding support beams to your building will improve stability.

UI.FTUE.FriendlyCharacters.src: Approach friendly characters to speak with them.

UI.FTUE.RespawningLocationBed.src: Because you have claimed a bed, you'll be returned there. Otherwise, you would be taken to the temple.

UI.FTUE.DurabilityDropText.src: As you use tools, armour and weapons, their durability decreases and they fall into disrepair. When they have no durability remaining they will break.

UI.FTUE.BetterGearText.src: As you venture further you will come across new materials, which will unlock new recipes. Crafting better equipment will increase your chances of survival.

UI.FTUE.ExploreText.src: Ashenfall is home to many useful resources, exploration will give you access to different materials.

UI.FTUE.FatigueText.src: Avoid exhaustion by getting a good night's sleep. If you're too tired, you'll find exploring much more difficult.

UI.FTUE.AccessSkills.src: Certain actions will award you XP in one of several skills. As you gain XP, your skills gain levels, which will give you access to new features and powerful spells.

UI.FTUE.CraftingItems.Text.src: Crafting benches allow you to create tools and other items.

UI.FTUE.FoodBenenfitsText.src: Eating food provides Sustenance, which improves health regeneration.

UI.FTUE.FirstArmorEquip.Text2.src: Enemy power levels are indicated next to their health bar. The higher the power level, the more dangerous the foe. Make sure you are properly equipped to face them.

UI.FTUE.CombatVsGoblinsText.src: Goblins? Aggressive critters. Keep your wits about you, damage avoided is better than damage blocked. Choose your attacks carefully.

UI.FTUE.RespawningLocationNoBed.src: If you have claimed a bed, you'll be returned there. Otherwise, you'll be taken to the temple.

UI.FTUE.CraftingStationText.src: Interact with crafting tables to create new tools and weapons, as well as repairing old ones.

UI.FTUE.BackpackText.src: Items and resources will be stored in your Backpack. Try not to overburden yourself by carrying too much.

UI.FTUE.AccessBuildMenu.src: Press {BuildMenuButton} to open the Build menu.

UI.FTUE.AccessInventory.src: Press {InventoryButton} to interact with your Inventory.

UI.FTUE.AccessSpells.src: Press {SpellBookButton} to open the spell book

UI.FTUE.Cooking.Text.src: Raw food is rarely edible, build a campfire to cook food on. A good meal will improve your health and stamina.

UI.FTUE.RuneEssenceText.src: Runes are crafted using rune essence, which can be mined at rune geysers all over the land.

UI.FTUE.RuneCraftingText.src: Runes can be crafted from rune essence at a rune altar.

UI.FTUE.CastSpells.src: Select a spell to cast it.

UI.FTUE.Beds.Claim.Text.src: Sleeping will allow you to skip the night and alleviate fatigue.

UI.FTUE.Beds.Shelter.Text.src: Some structures require a roof overhead. Make sure your giving yourself sufficient shelter.

UI.FTUE.SpellsAndRunesText.src: Spells require runes to cast them. They can be crafted using rune essence.

UI.FTUE.FirstNightText.src: The cold will lower your stamina, and the temperature drops harshly at night. Build a campfire to keep yourself warm.

UI.FTUE.UpgradingWorkstationsText.src: Upgrading a workstation increases its functionality, allowing you to craft better equipment.

UI.FTUE.RepairingItemsText.src: When an item breaks you can repair it at a crafting station.

UI.FTUE.HealthRegen.src: When your health isn't as good as it could be, a good meal will help restore you and bolster you for the journey ahead.

UI.FTUE.NeedStrongerAxeText.src: Yeah, your axe isn't going to cut it – pardon the pun – against a tree like that. You'll need a stronger axe.

UI.FTUE.NeedStrongerPickageText.src: Yeah, your pickaxe isn’t going to make a dent – pardon the pun – in ore like that. You’ll need a stronger pickaxe.

UI.FTUE.Encumbered.src: You are carrying too much. Keep an eye on the weight of everything in your inventory.

UI.FTUE.BuildingMaterialsText.src: You can convert logs into wooden planks, which can be used to construct a shelter.

UI.FTUE.AccessMap.src: You can open/close the map at any time by pressing {MapButton}.

UI.FTUE.Repair.Text.src: You can repair weapons, tools and armor at a Crafting Table, using resources you've gathered.

UI.FTUE.Building.Placement.Text.src: You can rotate and adjust the distance and height of a building piece before you place it.

UI.FTUE.Building.Stability.Text.src: You can't build just anywhere. Make sure your structure is stable enough to support itself. Structures are more stable if build near the ground.

UI.FTUE.Building.Unlocked.2.Text.src: You need a crafting table to craft tools.

UI.FTUE.RespawningText.src: You'll be whisked to safety on death, but your items will be left behind. {DescribeRespawningLocation}

UI.FTUE.AccessJournal.src: You've discovered a new recipe. Press {JournalButton} to see it in the journal.

UI.FTUE.FirstArmorEquipText.src: Your power level can be viewed in your inventory next to your equipped armour. The higher your power level, the better your chance of survival.

UI.FTUE.PowerLevels.Text.src: You’re entering an area with stronger creatures and enemies. Craft better weapons and armour to improve your chances of survival.

SoulRift.FTUE.ImarusGazeStage2.src: Imaru draws closer, find a Purification Pool to remove Soul Rift before its too late.

SoulRift.FTUE.ImarusGazeStage1.src: Imaru smells your soul, find a Purification Pool and remove Soul Rift before she finds you.

SoulRift.FTUE.PreventTeleport.src: Imaru's gaze prevents you from teleporting.

SoulRift.FTUE.ImarusGazeStage3.src: Intertact with a Purification Pool to remove the Soul Rift state.

GameplayEffect.LightArmorT2IncreaseMagic.src: Light Armor Set Magic Attack Speed

GameplayEffect.LightArmorT2ReduceConjuri.src: Light Armor Set Max Magic Conjuring Time

SoulRift.FTUE.MissedPool.src: Use your compass to find the closest Purification Pool.

SoulRift.FTUE.FirstInstance.src: You have become soul-rifted, and gained the attention of Imaru.

CharacterNameExistsErrorBody.src: A character with this name already exists. Please choose a different name or go back and delete the existing character.

NetworkUnknownErrorBody.src: An unknown network error has occurred. Please try again.

ConfirmDeleteCharacterBody.src: Are you sure you want to delete this character?

ConfirmDeleteWorldBody.src: Are you sure you want to delete this world?

ConfirmExitCharacterCreationBody.src: Are you sure you want to leave character creation? Your changes will be lost.

ConfirmExitCharacterEditBody.src: Are you sure you want to leave the character appearance editor? Your changes will be lost.

ConfirmResetKeybindingsBody.src:
Are your sure you want to reset all keybindings to default?
