Objective.DigUpTreasure.1.src: Dig up Forbidden Scrolls in the garou ruins. 1/4

Objective.DigUpTreasure.2.src: Dig up Forbidden Scrolls in the garou ruins. 2/4

Objective.DigUpTreasure.3.src: Dig up Forbidden Scrolls in the garou ruins. 3/4

Task2.Description.src: Dig up buried history in garou ruins far to the south

Task1.Objective.2.src: Follow the final clue to the last stone slab. Your Saga has been updated!

Task1.Description.src: Help Laguna - The Bard to find stone slabs in rocky spires around the pyramid

Objective.ReturnToArchaeologist.src: Return to Lehran - The Archaeologist in the Uzzer Camp

Task3.Objective.ReturnToShangruuh.src: Return to Shangruuh - Garou Envoy in the Uzzer Camp

Task3.Description.src: Stop the Uzzer tribe from making a mistake and binding themselves to Fuzan's Mark

Task1.Objective.Clues.1.src: Use your Saga to find clues towards the treasure

CitizenB.Incidental.3.src: At least, I hope it's still in us. Somewhere.

CitizenF.Incidental.2.src: But no-one going to help me, just 'cause I have no influence over the Elder.

CitizenC.Incidental.1.src: Everyone knows someone who was lost to the Dearg Due.

CitizenB.Incidental.1.src: Excuse us, adventurer. We are all in pain from Fuzan's Mark, which doesn't leave much room for courtesy and niceties.

CitizenA.Incidental.1.src: Fionn? Oh... sorry, I thought...  well, how could you be? It's been years now, I don't know why he'd come back.

CitizenF.Incidental.3.src: I could make you a Mirror Lens outta some polished buttons.

CitizenC.Incidental.2.src: It likes the restless ones - the garou who talk about leaving and finding another camp.

CitizenC.Incidental.3.src: It lures them out of camp and then crushes them in its maw. Bones break, bodies eaten.

CitizenE.Incidental.3.src: It's the Dearg Due, I reckon. A bad spirit, spinning about in the wastes.

CitizenD.Incidental.3.src: Nobody remembers what happened to them or how they found themselves in Manafem. But yeah, one of them was my great-great-great grandmother.

CitizenF.Incidental.1.src: Nobody thinks about the little guys. I got tasks, you know. Things that need doin'.

CitizenE.Incidental.2.src: Now, I ain't much of a weather person, but I know that sand can't whisper.

CitizenD.Incidental.2.src: Several garou cubs emerged from the Vault to the south. They had no memory and were shorn of anything that you could identify them by.

CitizenB.Incidental.2.src: Take the Mark from us, and I think you would find a strong, humble people.

CitizenE.Incidental.1.src: The sandstorm ain't natural. There's whispering in the centre of them.

CitizenA.Incidental.2.src: The sandstorm is deadlier than any dragon, young one. My son knew that and even though he took every precaution...

CitizenD.Incidental.1.src: They say that I am descended from the Children of the Vault.

CitizenA.Incidental.3.src: Yet, I can't kill this horrible hope in my heart. This poisonous feeling that he might return. Life is cruel, young one, best be ready for that.

Shaman_Return_NoSpace.src: Ah, you have no room for the gift that we wish to give you. Come back when you have space.

Objective1.src: Climb tall locations around the Alcarrid Camp and find their Moon Sprites

Objective3.src: Climb tall locations near Alcarrid Camp and find their Moon Sprites (0/3)

Objective4.src: Climb tall locations near Alcarrid Camp and find their Moon Sprites (1/3)

Objective5.src: Climb tall locations near Alcarrid Camp and find their Moon Sprites (2/3)

Objective6.src: Climb tall locations near Alcarrid Camp and find their Moon Sprites (3/3)

DummyMoonSprite.CompleteM2.1.src: Congratulations on finding us all! It makes us dance with delight that we got to help the Moon Garou map the area, puk puk!

QuestDesc.src: Discover Moon Sprites on top of tall locations around the Alcarrid Camp to map the Umbral Sands.

MoonSprite2_Lore_1.src: Garou lived in these ruins once, puk puk. The garou were not so kind to the Moon Sprites. They not trust us, nor did they trust Fuzan.

DummyMoonSprite.Started.1.src: If you're looking to map the area, you will want to be looking for Moon Sprites like us, puk puk. They will be slightly less handsome, though.

MoonSprite3_Lore2.src: It is not a nice place. It sucks anima from the world like roots from a tree. You have Moon Sprite permission to destroy it.

MoonSprite3_Lore1.src: Nearby is the Nightmare Crucible gate. That is not the name that Moon Sprites give it! Puk puk, it is the name given to it by an ancient race.

DummyMoonSprite.NotStarted.1.src: Ooh a human! Not seen one in centuries. You will want to talk to the Moon Sprite Shaman, puk puk.

Shaman_Return_QuestComplete.src: Peace to you, young one. The Moon Sprites are happy to see you.

Objective2.src: Return to the Moon Sprite Shaman in the Alcarrid Camp

Shaman_Return_4_DoneSprites.src: Take this reward. Return to me if you would consider mapping the rest of the Umbral Sands, not just around Alcarrid.

MoonSprites_NotStarted_1.src: Talk to Anamcara, the Moon Sprite Shaman in Alcarrid, puk puk! He will tell you what to do with us.

MoonSprite1_Lore_2.src: The KotHaar can tell how many months have passed from the erosion on the rocks. Very clever, puk puk!

MoonSprite1_Lore_1.src: The KotHaar stacked these rocks, puk puk! They built them before there was a bully called Fuzan. The rocks are a KotHaar calendar.

Shaman_Return_3_DoneSprites.src: The Moon Sprites and I cannot thank you enough. While it may seem like a small task, it's benefit is immeasurable.

Shaman_Return_1_NotComplete.src: The Moon Sprites await you on tall rocks and ruins around Alcarrid.

Intro_Shaman_3_NotStarted.src: The Moon Sprites have a task for you. Travel to the top of tall and rocky locations around this camp. There, some Sprites will be waiting for you.

Sprites_Found_1.src: The Moon Sprites have mapped this area! They wish to tell you a small story about what happened here...

Intro_Shaman_Generic.src: The Moon Sprites see you, adventurer.

Intro_Shaman_1_NotStarted.src: The Moon Sprites tell me that you are the one: the one prophesied to map the Umbral Sands.

MoonSprite2_Lore_2.src: The garou who lived here did not submit to Fuzan. And you can see what happened to them, puk!

Shaman_Return_2_DoneSprites.src: The next step is mine. I will use the information to make maps that can be distributed among the garou.

Shaman_Return_2_NotComplete.src: They look much like fireflies. Look at the ones next to me to understand what you are looking for. And please: do not wait much longer before you find them all.

Intro_Shaman_4_NotStarted.src: Use the Moon Sprites' power of echolocation to map the sands. Survey it. Then you will bring that knowledge back to me.

Intro_Shaman_2_NotStarted.src: While I am old, this clan is young. They may live in the Sands, but this clan does not understand it.

DummyMoonSprite.CompleteM1.1.src: You found us all! I bet the other Moon Sprites talked your ear off, didn't they?

Sprites_Found_Repeat.src: You have already found the Moon Sprites in this location. They repeat their story of what happened in this local region.

Sprites_Found_All.src: You have found all of the Moon Sprites! Return to Anamcara, the Moon Sprite Shaman, to give him the news.

Shaman_Return_1_DoneSprites.src: Young one, you have done it! The Moon Sprites have echolocated across our little corner of the Umbral Sands.

Shaman_Return_Sands2.src: And I am happy to see you too.

MoonSprite1_Lore_2.src: But Fuzan did not understand the limits of garou pain. He thought they could absorb as much torment as the KotHaar. Alas, puk puk, they could not.

MoonSprite8_Lore_2.src: But when our time comes, this is where we travel. We rise from this mountain and join the stars.

Objective1.src: Climb tall locations around Umbral Sands and find their Moon Sprites

Objective3.src: Climb tall locations around Umbral Sands and find their Moon Sprites (0/8)

Objective4.src: Climb tall locations around Umbral Sands and find their Moon Sprites (1/8)

Objective5.src: Climb tall locations around Umbral Sands and find their Moon Sprites (2/8)

Objective6.src: Climb tall locations around Umbral Sands and find their Moon Sprites (3/8)

Objective7.src: Climb tall locations around Umbral Sands and find their Moon Sprites (4/8)

Objective8.src: Climb tall locations around Umbral Sands and find their Moon Sprites (5/8)

Objective9.src: Climb tall locations around Umbral Sands and find their Moon Sprites (6/8)

Objective10.src: Climb tall locations around Umbral Sands and find their Moon Sprites (7/8)

QuestDesc.src: Discover Moon Sprites on top of tall locations around all of the Umbral Sands.

MoonSprite4_Lore_2.src: Do you know what we see there? We see a twisting thread of wind, leading back to Fuzan's Volcano. That is the source, puk puk. That is where they come from.

Intro_Shaman_Map2_NotStarted_4.src: Find the Sprites, unleash their powers of echolocation, and we will achieve something that no garou has ever done before: a map of the entirety of the Umbral Sands.

Intro_Shaman_Map2_NotStarted_1.src: Greetings, friend of the Moon Sprites.

MoonSprite6_Lore_2.src: Her name was Athrú. She was one of the few garou to backchat The Goddess, and that is what the Goddess liked most about her!

Shaman_Return_Map2_DoneSprites_1.src: If my back wasn't one fused vertebra, I would bow to you. Thank you, young one.

MoonSprite1_Lore_1.src: It may not look like it, but this is a site of significance, yes! This is where Fuzan first applied his Mark.

MoonSprite7_Lore_2.src: It would ring for the joining of garou. A beautiful ceremony that every Moon Sprite would try to attend, puk puk.

Shaman_Return_Map2_NotComplete_2.src: Make sure you have a magic carpet. I fear you will be unable to find the Moon Sprites without its aid.

Intro_Shaman_Map2_NotStarted_3.src: Moon Sprites are waiting for you atop the tallest locations in the regions that are outside of Alcarrid Oasis.

MoonSprite8_Lore_1.src: Moon Sprites live long, puk puk. Longer than your little mind could comprehend.

Shaman_Return_Map2_DoneSprites_3.src: Now, rest. You have travelled far and wide. You deserve serenity. That and a reward, of course.

Shaman_Return_QuestComplete.src: Peace to you, young one. The Moon Sprites are happy to see you.

Objective2.src: Return to the Moon Sprite Shaman in the Alcarrid Camp

MoonSprite3_Lore_2.src: She would sing and we would sing with her. She would dance and we would glide round her. We miss our mistress, yet we do not know if we should mourn her.

MoonSprites_NotStarted_1.src: Talk to Anamcara, the Moon Sprite Shaman in Alcarrid, puk puk! He will tell you what to do with us.

Shaman_Return_Map2_NotComplete_1.src: The Moon Sprites are widespread, beyond the barriers of this clan's land.

MoonSprite4_Lore_1.src: The Moon Sprites do not have eyes, so sand cannot clog them. We can see into the sandstorms.

Sprites_Found_1.src: The Moon Sprites have mapped this area! They wish to tell you a small story about what happened here...

MoonSprite3_Lore_1.src: The Moon Sprites have never had a master. But we have had a mistress, puk puk.

MoonSprite5_Lore_1.src: The Moon Sprites remember the Old Kingdom, puk puk! The garou seemed happier then. We think they had more to do.

Intro_Shaman_Generic.src: The Moon Sprites see you, adventurer.

Shaman_Return_Map2_DoneSprites_2.src: The map that you helped create will go to the Clan Elder. It will be foundational to every decision they make.

MoonSprite2_Lore_2.src: The terrible one sat here, puk puk. She sat here and snuffed out our lights for sport.

MoonSprite5_Lore_2.src: There was certainly lots to do in this place. Garou would trade food things back and forth, back and forth. Made Moon Sprites dizzy!

Shaman_Return_2_NotComplete.src: They are flighty. Impatient. Do not wait much longer before you find them all.

MoonSprite6_Lore_1.src: This was a home, puk puk. A home of someone who meant much to both us and the River Goddess.

MoonSprite7_Lore_1.src: This was once a belltower, puk puk. It would ring across the Umbral Sands.

MoonSprite2_Lore_1.src: We have seen three gods walk the sands of Umbral. One tall, one shining, one terrible.

Sprites_Found_Repeat.src: You have already found the Moon Sprites in this location. They repeat their story of what happened in this local region.

Sprites_Found_All.src: You have found all of the Moon Sprites! Return to Anamcara, the Moon Sprite Shaman, to give him the news.

Intro_Shaman_Map2_NotStarted_2.src: You may have guessed the next step. We have mapped our little wedge of land, but the Umbral Sands stretch further than that.

Vannaka_SpokenTo_SomeJournals.src: I see you've got one of their training journals. Good work, young pup, but I need all three to unravel their techniques.

Vannaka_MoreInfo_RatMaster_1.src: According to the records here, his name was Walthar Skrexis. Kept mostly to himself, and had terrible hygiene habits.

Summoner_Journal_2.src: After all, they may be big, scary and made of claws, but they might be the best friends I've ever had.

HoundMaster_Journal_3.src: All these mages and their complicated summoning and binding nonsense, and really all you need to do is throw them a decent steak every once in a while.

Vannaka_PostQuest.src: Being nice to demons, what utter nonsense.

Vannaka_Intro_1.src: Black Knights. I had hoped their special brand of madness had kept to the mainland, but here they are, even if they're not quite the knights I know.

RatMaster_Journal_3.src: But these hellrats? They live forever! An eternity of cute twitchy whiskers and fluffy little bellies in need of a scritch. What could be better?

Vannaka_MoreInfo_RatMaster_2.src: Countless reports from the custodial team about how he would leave crumbs and bits of food everywhere, constantly attracting vermin.

Vannaka_MoreInfo_Houndmaster_1.src: From what I can tell, before the maddening corruption took him over, he was a knight called Philius Rexiton.

Vannaka_MoreInfo_Houndmaster_3.src: He spends his time in the dungeons at the garrison, on the lower floors. There he seems to have gained the loyalty, or at least the service, of a whole pack of hellhounds.

Vannaka_SpokenTo_AllJournals_2.src: Huh? Really? I was expecting dark rites, sinister spells and all that Zamorakian magic nonsense, but it's just... treat them nice?

Vannaka_SpokenTo_AllJournals_3.src: I have a horrible feeling there's a metaphor there, but I'm too old and jaded to think about it. Here, you did what I asked, so I owe you something for your efforts.

HoundMaster_Journal_1.src: I know they're just demons, but they're such good girls. I taught Gnasher how to sit, and Fido how to fetch.

RatMaster_Journal_1.src: I love rats, they're so cute. What with their little whiskers and their adorable inability to control their bladder.

Summoner_Journal_1.src: I'm not sure if demons even have birthdays, but I think I should get Delrom a cake. It's the polite thing to do.

Book.TooDangerous.src: It's too dangerous to read this right now.

Objective_FindJournals_3.src:
Journal Pages Collected 3/3
Return to Vannaka

Vannaka_MoreInfo_Summoner_1.src: Lester Flament, is what the records say. Sounds like an odious person, unpopular even in a place like this.

Vannaka_MoreInfo_Summoner_2.src: Nowadays he's found wandering the crypts south of here, below the temple, with one eerily loyal demon.

Summoner_Journal_3.src: Oooh, I should make sure the cake has sprinkles!

Item_Description.src: Pages taken from the Journals of the Beast Tamers

Vannaka_MoreInfo_Houndmaster_2.src: Records seem to indicate that he was a noble with a love for dogs. So it makes sense that he would try and wield the power of dog-shaped demons.

Vannaka_MoreInfo_RatMaster_4.src: Seems he spends most of his time in the menagerie, southwest of here.

Vannaka_MoreInfo_RatMaster_3.src: Seems that he's still doing that, even with his mind turned to soup by this strange corruption madness.

HoundMaster_Journal_2.src: Sure, Fido came back with a junior knight's still beating heart in her mouth, instead of the ball, but she's trying, bless her.

PlayerChoice_MoreInfo_RatMaster.src: Tell me about the Rat Master

RatMaster_Journal_2.src: The tragedy being that they only live for such a short time. A year, maybe two. Barely a heartbeat.

Vannaka_SpokenTo_AllJournals_4.src: This trinket should help you with all these demonic creatures. I don't think we have the time for a friendlier approach.

Vannaka_Intro_2.src: Three of them seem particularly dangerous, having learned how to bind demonic beasts to their service somehow.

Vannaka_MoreInfo_Hook.src: What do you need, young pup?

Objective_Info_FoundJournal.src: You found some pages from a journal belonging to someone at Dowdun Reach. Vannaka may know more.

Vannaka_SpokenTo_AllJournals_1.src: You've got them all? Great, well done, young pup. Let's take a look at them then, see what sinister secrets they've learned...

Vannaka_SpokenTo_NoJournals.src: Young pup, I need you to track down three demon trainers and bring me their journals. I want to know what cruelties they have unleashed on the beasts here.

Vannaka_Intro_3.src: Young pup, I need you to track these three down and bring me their training manuals. I want to know what cruelties they have unleashed on the beasts here.

AbyssalWhipDesc.src: A brutal weapon crafted from the spine of a terrifying abyssal demon.

CrystalBowDesc.src: A powerful Shortbow fashioned from crystal of Elven origin.

GraniteMaulDesc.src: The power of this warhammer should not be taken for granite.

Doric_Optional_PlayerHasNoSpace.src: After begging for a reward, you haven't got any space free to carry it. Come back to me when you've got space in your pack.

Doric_Optional_PortalsActive_1.src: All the nodestones are up and running now, well done my friend, well done indeed!

Doric_Objective_Final_2.src: Definite egg on my face right now, haha. Still, did you get anything useful out of him? Oooh, a schematic eh? Let me take a look. Least I can do.

Doric_Objective_3_1.src: Elusive little blighter this one, ran straight past me again. You're catching up, I think.

Quest_Description.src: Unlock the portals around Dowdun Reach to help Doric track down the mage who stole his keepsake.

Doric_Optional_PortalsActive_4.src: Honestly, adventurers these days, bunch of mercenaries, the lot of 'em. Here, take these, they should help you out a bit.

Doric_PlayerSaidNo.src: I understand, you must be busy. If you get a chance though, come see me, I could really use your help.

Doric_Intro_2.src: It were a gift, you see, from me boy, Boric. It was the first thing he made when I finally let him at the forge. Took him hours it did, never been more proud.

Objective_Temple.src: Look for signs of the mugger-mage in the Cathedral in Dowdun Keep.

Objective_Garrison.src: Look for signs of the mugger mage in the Garrisons of Dowdun Keep.

Objective_Aquifer.src: Look for signs of the mugger mage in the underground Demon Gate of Dowdun Keep.

ZamorakMage_Note_2.src: Sacrifices essential... power not enough... must draw power from knights... demon is not ready! Must find gate!

Doric_Intro_4.src: See if you can follow him, find out where he went. It might help you unlock some of these 'ere nodestones which'll make getting round 'ere much easier!

Doric_Objective_1_NoProgress_2.src: See if you can follow him, find out where he went. It might help you unlock some of these 'ere nodestones which'll make getting round 'ere much easier!

Doric_Objective_Final_1.src: So... haha, you're not going to believe this, but that mage never took the dog at all. When he knocked into me, it fell outa me pocket and rolled behind a rock.

Doric_Objective_Final_3.src: Some sort of sinister staff. I can see how they might put something like this together. Here, let me teach you, my way of an apology for the wild goose chase.

Objective_ReturnToDoric.src: Speak to Doric in the Dowdun Reach nexus.

Doric_Intro_1.src: Thanks, I knew you were a good sort. So, you got here just after this blasted red wizard barged into me and mugged me. Took a little bronze dog on a keychain. I need it back.

Doric_Objective_1_NoProgress_1.src: That red-robed mage blindsided me and stole a beloved keepsake of mine. Why? Who knows.  Last I saw he went through a portal to some cathedral or other.

Doric_Intro_3.src: That wizard, he took it and then leapt straight through those lodestone-like things over there. There were a brief flash of pews and religious things, then he were gone.

ZamorakMage_Examine_1.src: The wounds are fresh. You've arrived just after this mage was brutally slaughtered. Their robes are singed and claw marks rake across what's left of their torso.

ZamorakMage_NoSignOfMugger.src: There's no sign of the mugger, but the nearby nodestone seems to crackle with lingering energy. Perhaps you just missed them.

ZamorakMage_TempleNote_1.src: These notes are incoherent ramblings about the nature of portal magic. Seems like the ones in the keep don't use runes, but are powered by the Dreaming Stone somehow.

ZamorakMage_GarrisonNote_1.src: These schematics seem to be something to do with emotion-based magic, as if trying to draw energy from suffering somehow. The notes suggest they intend to use it on some source of great suffering.

Doric_Objective_3_2.src: They went through the portal at the back there. I got a brief glimpse of glowing lights, water and rock. Some sort of sinister demonic gateway, maybe?

Doric_Objective_2_2.src: This time the portal seemed to be all chains, cells and angry-looking knights. Maybe a garrison or something? Best look around.

Doric_Optional_PortalsActive_3.src: What? You're expecting some sort of reward? Aren't all these handy shortcuts enough for you?

Doric_MainQuestHook.src: While I have you, would you mind helping me out with something else?

Doric_Objective_Final_4_PortalHook.src: While you're at it, these nodestones -- they feel like they'd be quite useful to have active. If you can get them all up and running come see me, I'll have a little something for you.

ZamorakMage_Examine_2.src: You fumble around their pockets, but find no sign of Doric's keepsake. Instead, you find a crumpled up schematic of some kind. Perhaps Doric can make sense of it.

Doric_Objective_2_1.src: You just missed that ruddy red mage. He ran right past me, waving a great spiky staff around without fear of poking anyone's eyes out.

Doric_Optional_PortalsActive_Some.src: You managed to get some of these nodestones working, great work! See if you can get the rest of them working!
